Further, retinotopic coding is intrinsic to the DN, persisting even during periods when the DN signal is elevated. These findings reveal a latent, voxel-level architecture of retinotopically grounded interactions between the DN and dATN. Taken together, our results suggest that retinotopic coding underpins the dynamic coordination of perception and thought in the human brain.

items.title: Wound-induced syncytia outpace mononucleate neighbors during Drosophila wound repair
items.abstract: In response to injury, cells proliferate, migrate, and invade to replace missing cells and close wounds. However, the role of other wound-induced cell behaviors is not understood, including the formation of syncytia (multinucleated cells). Here, we use in vivo live imaging to analyze wound-induced syncytia in mitotically competent Drosophila pupae. We find that almost half the epithelial cells near a wound fuse to form large syncytia. When the autophagy gene Atg1 is knocked down, fewer syncytia form, and wounds close more slowly. Further, a computational model of tissue fluidity indicates that cell fusion speeds wound closure time by about one-third. Syncytia use several routes to speed wound repair: they outpace diploid cells at the wound margin to lead the initial resealing of the wound; they reduce the need for intercalation as the tissue reshapes during closure; and they pool resources of their component cells to concentrate them toward the wound margin. In addition to wound healing, these properties of syncytia are likely to contribute to their roles in development and pathology.

items.title: Pathogenic O-GlcNAc dyshomeostasis is associated with cortical malformations and hyperactivity
items.abstract: Missense variants in the O-GlcNAc transferase ( OGT ) gene have recently been shown to segregate with a syndromic form of intellectual disability (OGT-ID), underscoring the importance of protein O-GlcNAcylation in brain function. However, the underlying pathophysiological mechanisms linking ID to potential OGT malfunction—whether developmental, neurophysiological, or both – remain unclear. Here, we present comprehensive analyses encompassing behaviour and brain architecture of a rodent model carrying the pathogenic C921Y OGT-ID variant. These mice show a range of behavioural deficits, including hyperactivity, impulsivity, and associative learning phenotypes. Structural studies, using micro-computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging, revealed reduced skull size, microcephaly, reduced cortical thickness and hypoplastic corpus callosum. Detailed histological analyses revealed dysplastic changes in the neocortex, predominantly affecting the superficial layers of the cingulate cortex. Mechanistically, quantitative proteomic analyses revealed O-GlcNAc dyshomeostasis associated with distinct perturbed molecular pathways involved in brain development. Taken together, these data reveal neurodevelopmental defects associated with O-GlcNAc dyshomeostasis and provide a platform for dissecting mechanism and treatments of OGT-ID.

items.title: PRMT1-SFPQ regulates intron retention to control matrix gene expression during craniofacial development
items.abstract: Spliceosomopathies, which are a group of disorders caused by defects in the splicing machinery, frequently affect the craniofacial skeleton and limb, but the molecular mechanism underlying this tissue-specific sensitivity remains unclear. Splicing factors and small nuclear ribonucleoproteins (snRNPs) are core components of splicing machinery, and splicing factors are further controlled by post-translational modifications, among which arginine methylation is one of the most prevalent. We determined the splicing mechanisms in the cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs), a multipotent developmental population that gives rise to the majority of the craniofacial skeleton, and focused on an upstream regulator of splicing proteins, protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1). PRMT1 is the highest expressing arginine methyltransferase in CNCCs, and its role in craniofacial development is evident from our earlier investigation, where CNCC-specific Prmt1 deletion caused cleft palate and mandibular hypoplasia. PRMT1 catalyzes arginine methylation of splicing factors to modify protein localization, expression, and activity. In the present study, we uncover roles of PRMT1 in the regulation of intron retention, a type of alternative splicing where introns are retained in the mature mRNA. CNCCs from the mandibular primordium of Prmt1 -deficient embryos demonstrated an increase in the percentage of intron-retaining mRNA of matrix genes, which triggered nonsense-mediated decay (NMD), causing a reduction in matrix mRNA abundance. We further identified SFPQ as a substrate of PRMT1 that depends on PRMT1 for arginine methylation and protein expression in the developing craniofacial structures. Depletion of SFPQ in CNCCs phenocopied PRMT1 deletion whereby matrix, Wnt signaling components, and neuronal gene transcripts contained higher IR and exhibited lower expression. We further recognized gene length as a common feature among SFPQ-regulated genes in CNCCs. Altogether, these findings demonstrate that the PRMT1-SFPQ pathway modulates matrix gene expression via IR-triggered NMD in CNCCs during craniofacial development.
items.title_zh: PRMT1-SFPQ调控内含子保留以控制颅面发育中的基因表达
items.summary_zh: 剪接体病是一类由剪接机制缺陷引起的疾病，常影响颅面骨骼和肢体，但其组织特异性敏感性的分子机制尚不清楚。剪接因子和小核核糖核蛋白（snRNPs）是剪接机制的核心成分，剪接因子还受到后转译修饰的调控，其中精氨酸甲基化最为普遍。我们研究了颅神经嵴细胞（CNCCs）的剪接机制，重点关注剪接蛋白的上游调控因子——精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）。PRMT1是CNCCs中表达最高的精氨酸甲基转移酶，其在颅面发育中的作用在我们之前的研究中已得到证实，CNCC特异性Prmt1缺失导致了腭裂和下颌发育不良。本研究揭示了PRMT1在内含子保留调控中的作用，内含子保留是一种在成熟mRNA中保留内含子的替代剪接类型。Prmt1缺失胚胎的下颌原基CNCCs显示内含子保留比例增加。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）通过调控内含子保留影响颅面发育中的基因表达，缺失Prmt1可导致腭裂和下颌发育不良。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了精氨酸甲基转移酶1（PRMT1）在颅神经嵴细胞（CNCCs）内含子保留调控中的作用，揭示了其对颅面发育中基因表达的影响。剪接体病是一类由剪接机制缺陷引起的疾病，通常影响颅面骨骼和肢体，但其组织特异性敏感性的分子机制尚不明确。剪接因子和小核核糖核蛋白（snRNPs）是剪接机制的核心成分，而剪接因子受到后转译修饰的调控，其中精氨酸甲基化是最为普遍的修饰形式。

在本研究中，研究团队重点关注了CNCCs中的PRMT1，发现其在该细胞类型中的表达水平最高。之前的研究已证实，CNCC特异性Prmt1缺失会导致腭裂和下颌发育不良，这为本研究提供了重要的背景。通过对Prmt1缺失胚胎的下颌原基CNCCs进行分析，研究发现内含子保留的比例显著增加。这一发现表明，PRMT1在调控内含子保留方面发挥了重要作用，而内含子保留是一种在成熟mRNA中保留内含子的替代剪接类型。

综上所述，本研究揭示了PRMT1在颅面发育中的关键调控作用，特别是在内含子保留的调控机制上。这一发现为理解剪接体病的组织特异性敏感性提供了新的分子机制视角，并可能为未来的治疗策略提供理论基础。

items.title: Correction: Degradation of LMO2 in T cell leukaemia results in collateral breakdown of transcription complex partners and causes LMO2-dependent apoptosis
Enhanced tactile coding in rat neocortex under darkness
items.abstract: Sensory systems are known for their adaptability, responding dynamically to changes in environmental conditions. A key example of this adaptability is the enhancement of tactile perception in the absence of visual input. Despite behavioral studies showing visual deprivation can improve tactile discrimination, the underlying neural mechanisms, particularly how tactile neural representations are reorganized during visual deprivation, remain unclear. In this study, we explore how the absence of visual input alters tactile neural encoding in the rat primary somatosensory cortex (S1). Rats were trained on a custom-designed treadmill with distinct tactile textures (rough and smooth), and local field potentials (LFPs) were recorded from S1 under light and dark conditions. Machine learning techniques, specifically a convolutional neural network, were used to decode the high-dimensional LFP signals. We found that the neural representations of tactile stimuli became more distinct in the dark, indicating a reorganization of sensory processing in S1 when visual input was removed. Notably, conventional amplitude-based analyses failed to capture these changes, highlighting the power of deep learning in uncovering subtle neural patterns. These findings offer new insights into how the brain rapidly adapts tactile processing in response to the loss of visual input, with implications for multisensory integration.

items.title: MATR3 is essential for oocyte growth and maturation quality through a dual molecular mechanism
items.abstract: The molecular mechanisms governing mRNA accumulation during oocyte growth, essential for developmental competence, remain poorly understood. This study investigates the role of Matrin-3 (MATR3), a highly expressed RNA-binding protein in growing oocytes (GOs), using oocyte-specific knockout mouse models and human oocyte maturation arrest (OMA) samples. The results showed that MATR3 was more abundant in GOs than fully grown oocytes (FGOs), highly expressed in the nucleus of non-surrounded nucleolus (NSN) oocytes, and exited the nucleus during the NSN-to-surrounded nucleolus (SN) transition. In OMA patients, MATR3 nuclear localization was missed, with smaller oocytes than FGOs. Further, Matr3 deletion in mouse GOs caused restricted oocyte growth, global transcription disorders, follicle development failure, blocked GO-granulosa cell communication (via reduced Gdf9 and Rdx expression), and infertility. Mechanistically, MATR3 regulated transcription by recruiting H3K9me2-demethylating lysine-specific demethylase 3B or binding target gene promoters, like Rdx . These findings reveal a critical role of MATR3 in orchestrating transcription and paracrine signaling during oogenesis and suggest its potential as a diagnostic and therapeutic target for OMA.

items.title: Asymmetric introgression and thermal advantage jointly drive climate-mediated lineage turnover in a mixed-ploidy reed
items.abstract: Species distribution forecasts often ignore intraspecific genetic variation, potentially missing climate-driven lineage shifts within native ranges. We integrated population genomics (495 individuals), common-garden experiments across four sites, and species distribution modeling (837 records) for three genetic lineages of Phragmites australis in China. The octoploid FEAU lineage (haplotype P) showed superior heat tolerance, with T crit 1.3 °C higher and T 50 0.8 °C higher than the cold-adapted tetraploid CN lineage (haplotypes O/M), and produced greater total biomass in three of four gardens. Genomic analyses revealed bidirectional but asymmetric introgression; admixed individuals exhibited a significant bias toward FEAU ancestry (61.1%), consistent with preferential backcrossing to the octoploid parent. Under the high-emission scenario SSP5-8.5 by 2070, highly suitable habitat for FEAU expanded by 18.6%, whereas CN showed a smaller relative increase, and the subtropical SW lineage remained stable. These results demonstrate that climate change interacts with intraspecific variation through thermal tolerance, biomass advantages, and asymmetric gene flow to drive potential lineage replacement within the native range, a process already suggested by field observations of FEAU expansion in a plateau lake. Our findings argue for integrating evolutionary history and genetic identity into ecological forecasting to better anticipate ecosystem responses under ongoing warming.

items.title: Infants at high and low likelihood for autism show different EEG developmental trajectories in speech tracking and statistical learning
items.abstract: Delayed onset of canonical babbling and first words is often reported in infants later diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder. Identifying the neural mechanisms underlying language acquisition in autism is therefore critical to inform early diagnosis, prognosis, and intervention strategies. In this study, we investigated two speech processing mechanisms previously identified as atypical in children and adults with autism: the neural ability to track syllables, and statistical learning, the capacity to detect speech regularities beneath surface variability. We recorded 83 longitudinal high-density electroencephalograms from 44 infants (2.5–22.6 months) at high (HL) and low (LL) likelihood for autism and assessed their verbal outcomes at 20 months. Neural entrainment was measured at syllable and word frequencies during exposure to a multi-speaker stream of concatenated tri-syllabic words, followed by a word recognition test using evoked response potential (ERP) recording. Our findings revealed reduced tracking abilities at the syllabic level in HL infants, a measure that correlated with verbal outcomes. While HL infants did not exhibit deficits in statistical learning itself, they displayed reduced novelty orientation during the word recognition test, indicated by a reduced late ERP. By contrast, multi-talker variability temporarily disrupted word segmentation around 12 months in LL infants, but not in HL infants, potentially reflecting decreased sensitivity to human voices variability in the HL group. These results emphasize the importance of longitudinal protocols employing online, implicit measures to track the hierarchical stages of speech processing in both HL and LL infants.

items.title: Linear antibody epitope prediction using AlphaFold2
items.abstract: Defining the binding epitopes of antibodies is essential for understanding how they bind to their antigens and perform their molecular functions. However, while determining linear epitopes of monoclonal antibodies can be accomplished utilizing well-established empirical procedures, these approaches are generally labor- and time-intensive, and costly. To take advantage of the recent advances in protein structure prediction algorithms available to the scientific community, we developed a calculation pipeline based on the localColabFold implementation of AlphaFold2 that can predict linear antibody epitopes by predicting the structure of the complex between antibody heavy and light chains and target peptide sequences derived from antigens. We found that this AlphaFold2 pipeline, which we call PAbFold, was able to accurately flag known epitope sequences for several well-known antibody targets (HA/Myc) when the target sequence was broken into small overlapping linear peptides and antibody complementarity determining regions were grafted onto several different antibody framework regions in the single-chain antibody fragment format. To determine if this pipeline was able to identify the epitope of a novel antibody with no structural information publicly available, we determined the epitope of a novel anti-SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid-targeted antibody using our method and then experimentally validated our computational results using peptide competition ELISA assays. These results indicate that the AlphaFold2-based PAbFold pipeline we developed is capable of accurately identifying linear antibody epitopes in a short time using just antibody and target protein sequences. This emergent capability of the method is sensitive to methodological details such as peptide length, AlphaFold2 neural network versions, and multiple-sequence alignment databases. PAbFold is available at https://github.com/jbderoo/PAbFold .

items.title: An applicable and efficient retrograde monosynaptic circuit mapping tool for larval zebrafish
items.abstract: The larval zebrafish is a vertebrate model for in vivo monitoring and manipulation of whole-brain neuronal activity. Tracing its neural circuits remains challenging. Here, we report an applicable methodology tailored for larval zebrafish to achieve efficient retrograde trans-monosynaptic tracing from genetically defined neurons via EnvA-pseudotyped glycoprotein-deleted rabies viruses. By combinatorially optimizing multiple factors involved, we identified the CVS strain trans-complemented with advanced expression of N2cG at 36 °C as the optimal combination. It yielded a tracing efficiency of up to 20 inputs per starter cell. Its low cytotoxicity enabled the viable labeling and calcium imaging of infected neurons 10 days post-infection, spanning larval ages commonly used for functional examination. Cre-dependent labeling was further developed to enable cell-type-specific input tracing and circuit reconstruction. We mapped cerebellar circuits and uncovered the ipsilateral preference and subtype specificity of granule cell-to-Purkinje cell connections. Our method offers an efficient way for tracing neural circuits in larval zebrafish.

items.title: DGKα and ζ deficiency causes regulatory T-cell dysregulation, destabilization, and conversion to pathogenic T-follicular helper cells to trigger IgG1-predominant autoimmunity
items.abstract: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) actively engage in immune suppression to prevent autoimmune diseases, but also inhibit anti-tumor immunity. Although Tregs express a TCR repertoire with relatively high affinities to self, they are normally quite stable, and their inflammatory programs are intrinsically suppressed. We report here that diacylglycerol kinases (DGK) α and ζ are crucial for homeostasis, suppression of proinflammatory programs, and stability of Tregs, and for enforcing their dependence on CD28 costimulatory signal. Treg-specific deficiency of both DGKα and ζ derails signaling, metabolic, and transcriptional programs in Tregs to cause dysregulated phenotypic and functional properties and to unleash conversion to pathogenic exTregs, especially exTreg-T follicular helper (Tfh) 2 cells, leading to uncontrolled effector T cell differentiation, deregulated germinal center B-cell responses, and IgG1/IgE predominant antibodies/autoantibodies, and multiorgan autoimmune diseases. Our data not only illustrate the crucial roles of DGKs in Tregs to maintain self-tolerance, but also unveil a Treg-to-self-reactive-pathogenic-exTreg-Tfh-cell program that is suppressed by DGKs and that could exert broad pathogenic roles in autoimmune diseases if unchecked.
items.title_zh: DGKα和ζ缺失导致调节性T细胞失调及自身免疫病
items.summary_zh: 调节性T细胞（Tregs）在免疫抑制中发挥重要作用，以防止自身免疫疾病，但也抑制抗肿瘤免疫。我们发现二酰基甘油激酶（DGK）α和ζ对Tregs的稳态、抑制促炎程序和稳定性至关重要。Treg特异性缺失DGKα和ζ会导致Tregs的信号传导、代谢和转录程序失调，进而引发表型和功能特性失调，促进转化为致病性外周Tregs，尤其是外周Tfh2细胞，导致效应T细胞分化失控、胚中心B细胞反应失调以及以IgG1/IgE为主的抗体/自身抗体产生，最终引发多脏器自身免疫疾病。我们的数据不仅说明DGKs在维持自我耐受中的关键作用，还揭示了一个由DGKs抑制的Treg转化为自我反应性致病性外周Tfh细胞的程序，该程序在自身免疫疾病中可能发挥广泛的致病作用。
items.l1_lead: DGKα和ζ的缺失导致调节性T细胞功能失调，促进致病性外周T细胞的转化，从而引发多脏器自身免疫疾病。
items.l2_summary:
调节性T细胞（Tregs）在免疫系统中发挥着重要的免疫抑制作用，能够有效防止自身免疫疾病的发生，但同时也会抑制抗肿瘤免疫。近期研究发现，二酰基甘油激酶（DGK）α和ζ在维持Tregs的稳态、抑制促炎程序及其稳定性方面至关重要。通过对Treg特异性缺失DGKα和ζ的实验观察，研究表明，这种缺失会导致Tregs的信号传导、代谢和转录程序出现失调，进而引发Tregs的表型和功能特性失常。这种失调促使Tregs转化为致病性外周Tregs，尤其是外周Tfh2细胞，导致效应T细胞的分化失控，胚中心B细胞反应失调，并以IgG1/IgE为主的抗体及自身抗体的产生增加，最终引发多脏器的自身免疫疾病。

研究数据表明，DGKs在维持自我耐受中扮演着关键角色，揭示了一个由DGKs抑制的Treg转化为自我反应性致病性外周Tfh细胞的程序。这一程序在自身免疫疾病的发生中可能发挥着广泛的致病作用。通过深入分析DGKα和ζ的功能，研究为理解自身免疫疾病的机制提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗策略指明了方向。

items.title: Environmental temperature is a strong driver of subspecies competition in the Drosophila microbiome
items.abstract: Most microbiome research focuses on the taxonomic composition at the species level to understand the impact of environmental factors, but intraspecific diversity has largely been ignored. To address this significant knowledge gap, we took advantage of the simple, culturable microbiome of Drosophila . First, we documented that natural populations of D. simulans harbor three diverged clades of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum , a key nutritional symbiont. We studied the distinct ecological roles of these three clades by exposing flies with their native microbiome to two temperature regimes in the laboratory. Tracking the three clades within the complete Drosophila microbiome over a period of more than 10 years at two temperatures, we identified strikingly distinct dynamics in response to the selection regime. We confirmed the functional differentiation of the three clades using in vitro growth measurements and in vivo mono-association assays. Our results highlight that environmental selection operates at the subspecies level. Therefore, we conclude that the functional diversification of the microbiome can only be understood when intra- and interspecific diversity is considered.
items.title_zh: 环境温度是果蝇微生物组亚种竞争的重要驱动因素
items.summary_zh: 大多数微生物组研究集中在物种层面的分类组成上，忽视了种内多样性。为填补这一知识空白，我们利用果蝇简单且可培养的微生物组进行研究。首先，我们记录到自然种群的D. simulans中存在三种分化的Lactiplantibacillus plantarum类群，这是一种关键的营养共生体。通过在实验室中将果蝇及其原生微生物组暴露于两种温度条件下，我们研究了这三种类群的不同生态角色。在超过10年的时间里，我们追踪了这三种类群在完整果蝇微生物组中的动态变化，发现它们对选择条件的反应截然不同。通过体外生长测量和体内单一共生实验，我们确认了这三种类群的功能差异化。我们的结果强调了环境选择在亚种水平上的作用，因此我们得出结论，只有考虑种内和种间多样性，才能理解微生物组的功能多样化。
items.l1_lead: 环境温度显著影响果蝇微生物组中亚种的竞争与功能多样性，强调了种内多样性在微生物组研究中的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于果蝇（Drosophila simulans）微生物组中的种内多样性，探讨环境温度对微生物组亚种竞争的影响。以往的微生物组研究多集中于物种层面的分类组成，忽视了种内的多样性。为填补这一知识空白，研究团队观察到在自然种群的果蝇中存在三种分化的Lactiplantibacillus plantarum类群，这是一种重要的营养共生体。研究通过将果蝇及其原生微生物组在实验室中暴露于两种不同的温度条件下，分析了这三种类群在不同环境下的生态角色。

在超过10年的时间里，研究者们追踪了这三种类群在完整果蝇微生物组中的动态变化，发现它们对选择条件的反应截然不同。通过体外生长测量和体内单一共生实验，研究确认了这三种类群在功能上的差异化。这些结果表明，环境选择在微生物组的亚种水平上起着重要作用，强调了在理解微生物组的功能多样化时，必须考虑种内和种间的多样性。

综上所述，本研究揭示了环境温度作为果蝇微生物组亚种竞争的重要驱动因素，强调了种内多样性在微生物组功能研究中的重要性。这一发现为未来微生物组的研究提供了新的视角，提示科学家们在研究微生物组时应更加关注种内的生态动态。

items.title: The power of theory in the life sciences
items.abstract: The rapid growth of high-throughput biology and genomics over the past two decades has helped catalogue many different aspects of gene function in diverse cell types and conditions. More recently, advances in artificial intelligence and deep learning have shown tremendous promise in making accurate predictions of functional genomics measurements. These advances make it tempting to equate experimental cataloguing and accurate prediction with the growth of our theoretical understanding of biological processes – an equivalence we believe is ultimately misleading.

items.title: Defective neuronal differentiation in Lowe syndrome is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired cilia-related Sonic Hedgehog signaling
items.abstract: Human brain development requires tight coordination of metabolic and signaling pathways. Lowe syndrome (LS) is a recessive X-linked disorder characterized by proximal tubular renal disease, congenital cataracts, glaucoma, and neurodevelopmental delays. While LS results from mutations in the OCRL gene, which encodes an inositol polyphosphate 5-phosphatase, the cellular mechanisms driving neuronal dysfunction remain poorly understood. In this study, using patient-derived iPSC neurons, an Ocrl knockout mouse model, and an independent zebrafish OCRL-deficient model, we identified mitochondrial dysfunction as a conserved phenotype of OCRL loss across species. Collectively, our findings showed that OCRL deficiency leads to reduced mitochondrial activity, decreased mtDNA levels, reduced mitochondrial content (TOM20), and increased oxidative stress. We further showed that OCRL-deficient neural cells exhibited an altered balance of neuronal versus astrocytic differentiation, rather than a defect in neurogenesis. Additionally, we observed impaired Sonic Hedgehog (Shh) signaling and ciliary homeostasis. Thus, our findings support a model in which OCRL deficiency is associated with mitochondrial dysfunction, increased oxidative stress, altered neural lineage balance, and reduced Hedgehog pathway activity, providing a framework for understanding these interconnected phenotypes.
items.title_zh: 洛韦综合征中神经分化缺陷与线粒体功能障碍及纤毛相关信号通路受损相关
items.summary_zh: 洛韦综合征（LS）是一种隐性X连锁疾病，表现为近端肾小管病、先天性白内障、青光眼和神经发育延迟。本研究使用患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）神经元、Ocrl基因敲除小鼠模型及独立的缺乏OCRL的斑马鱼模型，发现线粒体功能障碍是OCRL缺失的保守表型。研究结果显示，OCRL缺失导致线粒体活性降低、线粒体DNA水平减少、线粒体含量（TOM20）减少及氧化应激增加。此外，OCRL缺失的神经细胞表现出神经元与星形胶质细胞分化平衡的改变，而非神经发生缺陷。同时，我们观察到Sonic Hedgehog（Shh）信号通路和纤毛稳态受损。因此，研究结果支持OCRL缺失与线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激增加、神经谱系平衡改变及Hedgehog通路活性降低相关的模型，为理解这些相互关联的表型提供了框架。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现洛韦综合征中OCRL缺失导致线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激增加及神经分化平衡改变，揭示了其与Hedgehog信号通路受损的关联。
items.l2_summary:
洛韦综合征（Lowe Syndrome, LS）是一种隐性X连锁遗传疾病，主要表现为近端肾小管病、先天性白内障、青光眼以及神经发育延迟。本研究通过使用患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（induced pluripotent stem cells, iPSC）神经元、Ocrl基因敲除小鼠模型以及缺乏OCRL的斑马鱼模型，探讨了OCRL缺失与线粒体功能障碍及纤毛相关信号通路受损之间的关系。研究发现，线粒体功能障碍是OCRL缺失的一个保守表型，具体表现为线粒体活性降低、线粒体DNA水平减少、线粒体含量（TOM20）减少以及氧化应激增加。

此外，缺失OCRL的神经细胞在神经元与星形胶质细胞的分化平衡上出现了显著改变，而并非表现出神经发生的缺陷。这一发现提示，OCRL缺失可能影响神经细胞的分化过程，从而导致神经发育延迟。同时，研究还观察到Sonic Hedgehog（Shh）信号通路和纤毛稳态的受损，进一步支持了OCRL缺失与多种细胞功能障碍之间的关联。

综上所述，本研究的结果为理解洛韦综合征中OCRL缺失所引发的线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激增加、神经谱系平衡改变及Hedgehog信号通路活性降低提供了重要的实验依据和理论框架。这些发现不仅揭示了洛韦综合征的潜在病理机制，也为未来的治疗策略提供了新的思路。

items.title: Synergistic inhibition of Notch signaling and forced cell cycle re-entry drive Müller glia reprogramming in uninjured mouse retina
items.abstract: In regenerative species, such as teleost fish, Müller glia (MG) autonomously re-enter the cell cycle after injury and give rise to functional retinal neurons. In contrast, the loss of retinal neurons in mammals is irreversible due to the limited proliferative and regenerative ability of MG. Various strategies have been developed to induce proliferation of mature mouse MG with or without injury, yet most MG daughter cells retain glial cell fate. Here, we found that MG progenies maintain high Notch signaling, which may constrain their neurogenic potential. Conditional deletion of Rbpj , the central transcriptional effector of Notch, induced limited MG-to-neuron conversion in mature MG without proliferation. However, Rbpj deletion, combined with forced MG proliferation by overexpressing Ccnd1 and suppressing Cdkn1b , significantly promoted MG dedifferentiation and ectopic expression of the neuronal marker Otx2 in MG daughter cells in uninjured mouse retina. Combining Notch inhibition with MG cell cycle re-activation not only increased the numbers of bipolar- and amacrine-like cells generated from MG but also promoted the further differentiation toward ON-cone, OFF-cone, and rod-bipolar subtypes. Single-nucleus RNA and ATAC sequencing data revealed that Notch inhibition facilitated the formation of MG-derived progenitor-like cells while MG proliferation increased chromatin accessibility of neurogenic genes. Notably, most MG-derived cells survived long term despite incomplete maturation. Together, our findings delineate how Notch inhibition and MG proliferation, alone or in combination, influence the regenerative potential of MG in the mammalian retina.
items.title_zh: Notch信号抑制与细胞周期重启促进小鼠视网膜Müller胶质细胞重编程
items.summary_zh: 在再生物种如硬骨鱼中，Müller胶质细胞（MG）在受伤后能够自主重返细胞周期并生成功能性视网膜神经元。相比之下，哺乳动物视网膜神经元的丧失是不可逆的，因MG的增殖和再生能力有限。我们发现MG后代维持高水平的Notch信号，这可能限制其神经发生潜力。条件性删除Notch的中心转录效应因子Rbpj，在成熟MG中诱导了有限的MG转化为神经元，而未发生增殖。然而，结合Rbpj缺失与通过过表达Ccnd1和抑制Cdkn1b强制MG增殖，显著促进了MG去分化及在未受伤小鼠视网膜中MG后代细胞中异常表达神经元标记物Otx2。Notch抑制与MG细胞周期重启的结合，不仅增加了从MG生成的双极细胞和无长突细胞的数量，还促进了向ON-锥体、OFF-锥体和杆状双极亚型的进一步分化。单细胞核RNA和ATAC测序数据表明，Notch抑制促进了MG来源的祖细胞样细胞的形成，而MG增殖则增加了染色质的可及性。
items.l1_lead: Notch信号的抑制与细胞周期的重启相结合，显著促进了小鼠视网膜Müller胶质细胞的重编程和神经元分化。
items.l2_summary:
在再生能力强的物种如硬骨鱼中，Müller胶质细胞（MG）能够在受伤后重新进入细胞周期并生成功能性视网膜神经元。然而，哺乳动物的视网膜神经元一旦丧失则无法恢复，MG的增殖和再生能力受到限制。研究发现，MG后代维持高水平的Notch信号，这可能抑制其神经发生潜力。通过条件性删除Notch的中心转录效应因子Rbpj，研究者在成熟MG中诱导了有限的MG转化为神经元，但未观察到细胞增殖的现象。

进一步的实验表明，将Rbpj缺失与过表达Ccnd1（细胞周期蛋白D1）和抑制Cdkn1b（细胞周期抑制因子1B）结合使用，可以强制MG增殖，从而显著促进MG的去分化，并在未受伤的小鼠视网膜中观察到MG后代细胞异常表达神经元标记物Otx2。Notch信号的抑制与MG细胞周期的重启相结合，不仅增加了从MG生成的双极细胞和无长突细胞的数量，还促进了这些细胞向ON-锥体、OFF-锥体和杆状双极亚型的进一步分化。

通过单细胞核RNA和ATAC测序数据的分析，研究结果显示，Notch信号的抑制促进了MG来源的祖细胞样细胞的形成，而MG的增殖则增加了染色质的可及性。这些发现表明，Notch信号的抑制与细胞周期的重启是促进小鼠视网膜Müller胶质细胞重编程的重要机制，为未来的视网膜再生研究提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: Screening the MMV Pathogen Box reveals the mitochondrial bc 1 -complex as a drug target in mature Toxoplasma gondii bradyzoites
items.abstract: The apicomplexan parasite Toxoplasma gondii infects 25–30% of the global human population and can cause life-threatening diseases in immunocompromised patients. The chronically infectious forms of the parasite, bradyzoites, persist within cysts in brain and muscle tissue, and are responsible for its transmission and remission of the disease. Currently available treatment options are very limited and are only effective against the fast-replicating tachyzoites, but fail to eradicate the chronic stages of T. gondii . The cause of these treatment failures remains unclear. Here, we utilized our recently developed human myotube-based culture model to screen compounds from the MMV Pathogen Box against pan-resistant in vitro bradyzoites, and identified multiple compounds with simultaneous activity against tachyzoites and bradyzoites. Stable isotope-resolved metabolic profiling on tachyzoites and bradyzoites identified the mitochondrial bc 1 -complex as a target of bradyzocidal compounds and defined their metabolic impacts on both parasite forms. Our data suggest that mature bradyzoites rely on mitochondrial ATP production.

items.title: Modulating task-outcome value to mitigate real-world procrastination via noninvasive brain stimulation
items.abstract: Procrastination is a prevalent behavioral problem associated with individual health and societal productivity. A leading model posits that procrastination reflects an imbalance between task aversiveness and the pursuit of positive task outcomes, yet this theoretical framework has neither been validated in real-world settings nor effectively applied to guide interventions. To address this gap, we conducted a double-blind, randomized, sham-controlled trial. Adults with chronic procrastination received seven sessions of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Using the intensive experience sampling method, we assessed the effect of anodal HD-tDCS on real-world procrastination behavior at offline after-effect (2-day interval) and long-term after-effect (6-month follow-up). This neuromodulation produced a lasting reduction in real-world procrastination, with effects sustained at a 6-month follow-up. The mediation analysis indicated that increased outcome value, but not reduced task aversiveness, statistically accounted for variation in behavioral improvement. These findings are consistent with the hypothesis that enhancing DLPFC function may reduce procrastination by selectively amplifying the valuation of future rewards, not by reducing negative feelings about the task, which also suggests a targeted, theory-informed avenue for future behavioral interventions.

items.title: A systematic interactome of Saccharomyces cerevisiae SET1C expands its functional landscape and identifies candidate regulatory connections
items.abstract: Set1 is the catalytic subunit of SET1C or COMPASS, which methylates histone H3K4 and serves as a scaffold for the association of seven tightly bound polypeptides. We have employed yeast two-hybrid screenings to determine the interactome of Set1 and each subunit, providing a unique resource for exploring known and novel roles of the complex. Our screenings identified a multitude of potential interactors involved in chromatin regulation, DNA replication, meiotic breaks, and Ty transposition, processes previously associated with SET1C. Consistent with Set1 being an RNA-binding protein, the screens link SET1C to multiple aspects of RNA biogenesis, including pre-mRNA splicing and polyadenylation. The results reveal that several importins are candidate interactors of Set1, along with RGG motif-containing proteins, providing insights into the mechanisms by which Set1 moves between cytoplasmic and nuclear compartments. We further reveal that reconstituted SET1C interacts with the AT-hook domain of the chromatin remodeler Snf2 and methylates multiple arginines within this domain. In vivo, we report that the ARTSTRGR AT-hook motif is methylated in a Set1-dependent manner, revealing new interplay between lysine and arginine methylation.
items.title_zh: 酿酒酵母SET1C系统互作组扩展功能景观并识别候选调控连接
items.summary_zh: Set1是SET1C或COMPASS的催化亚单位，负责甲基化组蛋白H3K4，并作为七个紧密结合多肽的支架。我们采用酵母双杂交筛选确定了Set1及其每个亚单位的互作组，为探索该复合体的已知和新角色提供了独特资源。筛选结果识别出多种潜在互作因子，涉及染色质调控、DNA复制、减数分裂断裂和Ty转位等过程，这些过程与SET1C相关。结果显示，Set1作为RNA结合蛋白，SET1C与RNA生物合成的多个方面相关，包括前mRNA剪接和多腺苷酸化。此外，我们发现多个进口蛋白和含RGG基序的蛋白是Set1的候选互作因子，揭示了Set1在细胞质和细胞核之间移动的机制。我们进一步发现重组SET1C与染色质重塑因子Snf2的AT-hook结构域相互作用，并对该结构域内的多个精氨酸进行甲基化。在体内，我们报告ARTSTRGR AT-hook基序以Set1依赖的方式被甲基化，揭示了赖氨酸与精氨酸甲基化之间的新相互作用。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现酿酒酵母SET1C系统通过与多种互作因子的相互作用，扩展了其功能景观，并揭示了Set1在RNA生物合成及细胞质与细胞核间移动中的新角色。
items.l2_summary:
Set1是SET1C（COMPASS复合体）的催化亚单位，主要负责组蛋白H3K4的甲基化，并作为七个紧密结合多肽的支架。为了深入探讨SET1C的功能，我们采用酵母双杂交筛选技术，确定了Set1及其各个亚单位的互作组，这为研究该复合体的已知和新角色提供了独特的资源。筛选结果揭示了多种潜在的互作因子，这些因子涉及染色质调控、DNA复制、减数分裂断裂以及Ty转位等过程，均与SET1C密切相关。

研究表明，Set1不仅是一个关键的甲基化酶，还作为RNA结合蛋白参与RNA生物合成的多个方面，包括前mRNA剪接和多腺苷酸化。此外，我们发现多个进口蛋白和含RGG基序的蛋白是Set1的候选互作因子，这一发现揭示了Set1在细胞质和细胞核之间移动的潜在机制。进一步的实验显示，重组SET1C与染色质重塑因子Snf2的AT-hook结构域发生相互作用，并对该结构域内的多个精氨酸进行甲基化修饰。

在体内实验中，我们报告了ARTSTRGR AT-hook基序以Set1依赖的方式被甲基化，这一发现揭示了赖氨酸与精氨酸甲基化之间的新相互作用。这些结果不仅扩展了SET1C的功能景观，还为理解其在细胞内的多重角色提供了新的视角，特别是在调控基因表达和细胞周期进程中的重要性。通过这些研究，我们为未来的相关研究奠定了基础，并为探索SET1C在不同生物学过程中的作用提供了新的线索。

items.title: The chromokinesin Kid (KIF22) forms a homodimer, moves processively along microtubules, and transports double-stranded DNA
items.abstract: During prometaphase in mitosis, chromosomes are pushed toward the spindle equator. The chromokinesin Kid, also known as KIF22, moves chromosomes along spindle microtubules during prometaphase. Kid has long been considered a monomeric and nonprocessive motor, different from typical kinesins. In this study, we demonstrate that the full-length Kid forms a homodimer and moves processively along microtubules. A conserved coiled-coil domain within the stalk region of Kid is sufficient for homodimer formation and is required for the processivity of Kid. Furthermore, the neck linker and coiled-coil domains of Kid could add processive activity to the motor domain of KIF1A, suggesting that Kid contains a functional neck linker and dimerization capability, a prerequisite for the processivity of kinesin motor domains. The full-length Kid, containing a helix–hairpin–helix domain, can transport double-stranded DNA along microtubules in vitro. AlphaFold3 prediction suggests that the dimerization of Kid stabilizes the association with DNA. These findings collectively suggest the reclassification of Kid as a processive and dimeric motor that transports DNA along microtubules.
items.title_zh: 染色体动力蛋白Kid（KIF22）形成同源二聚体并沿微管有序移动
items.summary_zh: 在有丝分裂的前中期，染色体被推向纺锤体赤道。染色体动力蛋白Kid（KIF22）在此过程中沿纺锤微管移动。长期以来，Kid被认为是单体且非有序的马达，与典型的动力蛋白不同。本研究表明，全长Kid形成同源二聚体，并能沿微管有序移动。Kid的茎区内一个保守的螺旋-螺旋结构域足以促进二聚体形成，并对Kid的有序性至关重要。此外，Kid的颈部连接器和螺旋-螺旋结构域能够为KIF1A的马达域增加有序活性，表明Kid具备功能性的颈部连接器和二聚化能力，这是动力蛋白马达域有序性的前提。全长Kid含有螺旋-发夹-螺旋结构域，能够在体外沿微管运输双链DNA。AlphaFold3预测显示，Kid的二聚化稳定了与DNA的结合。这些发现共同表明，Kid应重新分类为一种有序的二聚体马达，能够沿微管运输DNA。
items.l1_lead: 本研究发现染色体动力蛋白Kid（KIF22）形成同源二聚体，并能够有序地沿微管移动，重新定义其作为一种有序的马达，具备运输DNA的功能。
items.l2_summary:
在有丝分裂的前中期，染色体被推向纺锤体赤道，染色体动力蛋白Kid（KIF22）在这一过程中沿着纺锤微管进行移动。长期以来，Kid被认为是单体且非有序的马达，与典型的动力蛋白存在显著差异。然而，本研究揭示了全长Kid能够形成同源二聚体，并且能够沿微管有序移动的特性。研究发现，Kid的茎区内存在一个保守的螺旋-螺旋结构域，这一结构域不仅足以促进二聚体的形成，而且对Kid的有序性至关重要。

此外，Kid的颈部连接器和螺旋-螺旋结构域能够增强KIF1A的马达域的有序活性，表明Kid具备功能性的颈部连接器和二聚化能力，这些特性是动力蛋白马达域有序性的基础。全长Kid还包含螺旋-发夹-螺旋结构域，能够在体外沿微管运输双链DNA。通过AlphaFold3的预测，研究显示Kid的二聚化能够稳定其与DNA的结合。

这些发现共同表明，Kid应重新分类为一种有序的二聚体马达，具备沿微管运输DNA的能力。这一研究不仅为理解染色体动力蛋白的功能提供了新的视角，也为进一步探索细胞分裂过程中的分子机制奠定了基础。

items.title: Larger language models better align with neural representations of natural language
items.abstract: Recent research has used large language models (LLMs) to study the neural basis of naturalistic language processing in the human brain. LLMs have rapidly grown in complexity, leading to improved language processing capabilities. Here, we utilized several families of transformer-based LLMs to investigate the relationship between model size and their ability to capture linguistic information in the human brain. Crucially, a subset of LLMs were trained on a fixed training set, enabling us to dissociate model size from architecture and training set size. We used electrocorticography (ECoG) to measure neural activity in epilepsy patients while they listened to a 30 min naturalistic audio story. We fit electrode-wise encoding models using contextual embeddings extracted from each hidden layer of the LLMs to predict word-level neural signals. In line with prior work, we found that larger LLMs better capture the structure of natural language and better predict neural activity. We also found a logarithmic relationship where the encoding performance peaks in relatively earlier layers as model size increases. We also observed variations in the best-performing layer across different brain regions, corresponding to an organized language processing hierarchy.

items.title: Correction: Post-retrieval noradrenergic activation impairs subsequent memory depending on cortico-hippocampal reactivation
Rank- and threat-dependent social modulation of innate defensive behaviors
items.abstract: Fear and defense are among the most fundamental survival behaviors and are profoundly influenced by the social environment in group-living animals. However, it remains poorly understood how social context—and particularly dominance hierarchy, a defining feature of many social species—modulates defensive strategies under naturalistic conditions. To address this question, we investigated the social modulation of innate fear in mice exposed to two ethologically relevant threats: a transient visual looming stimulus and a sustained predatory threat posed by a live rat. We found that social presence alleviated threat-induced stress and modulated defensive behaviors in a rank- and threat-specific manner. During looming exposure, it reduced immediate defensive responses and alleviated post-looming anxiety, with dominants deriving greater benefit. During rat exposure, it promoted a shift from passive to active defense, again most prominently in dominants. These behavioral changes were accompanied by reorganization of transitions between defensive states, indicating that dominance hierarchy shapes both the expression and temporal organization of innate defensive behaviors. Conversely, threat exposure strengthened social engagement, with dominant mice exhibiting more proactive social behaviors and subordinate mice responding more readily to dominant social initiations. Together, these findings demonstrate how dominance hierarchy modulates defensive responses to distinct naturalistic threats and, in turn, how threat experience shapes social behavior, providing a behavioral framework for probing the neural basis of socially modulated innate fear.

items.title: Comprehensive RNA velocity by modeling the cascade of gene regulation, transcription, and splicing from single-cell RNA sequencing data with TSvelo
items.abstract: RNA velocity approaches fit gene dynamics and infer cell fate by modeling the splicing process using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data. However, due to the short time scale of splicing, high noise, and large complexity of data, existing RNA velocity methods often fail to precisely capture the complex velocity dynamics for individual genes and single cells, which makes their downstream analysis less reliable and less robust. We propose TSvelo , a comprehensive RNA velo city mathematics framework that can model the cascade of gene regulation, T ranscription and S plicing using highly interpretable neural ordinary differential equations. TSvelo can precisely capture the transcription–unspliced–spliced 3D dynamics of all genes simultaneously, infer unified latent time shared by genes within a single cell, and be applied to multi-lineage datasets. Experiments on six scRNA-seq datasets, including two multi-lineage datasets, demonstrate TSvelo’s superiority.
items.title_zh: 基于TSvelo的全面RNA速度模型研究
items.summary_zh: RNA速度方法通过建模剪接过程，利用单细胞RNA测序(scRNA-seq)数据来拟合基因动态和推断细胞命运。然而，由于剪接的短时间尺度、高噪声和数据复杂性，现有RNA速度方法往往无法精确捕捉单个基因和单个细胞的复杂速度动态，从而降低下游分析的可靠性和稳健性。我们提出了TSvelo，一个全面的RNA速度数学框架，能够使用高度可解释的神经常微分方程建模基因调控、转录和剪接的级联过程。TSvelo能够同时精确捕捉所有基因的转录-未剪接-剪接三维动态，推断单个细胞内基因共享的统一潜在时间，并可应用于多谱系数据集。在六个scRNA-seq数据集上的实验，包括两个多谱系数据集，验证了TSvelo的优越性。
items.l1_lead: TSvelo是一种全面的RNA速度模型，通过神经常微分方程精确捕捉基因转录和剪接动态，显著提升了单细胞RNA测序数据分析的可靠性和稳健性。
items.l2_summary:
RNA速度方法通过建模剪接过程，利用单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据来拟合基因动态和推断细胞命运。然而，现有的RNA速度方法在面对剪接的短时间尺度、高噪声和数据复杂性时，往往无法准确捕捉单个基因和单个细胞的复杂速度动态，这导致下游分析的可靠性和稳健性受到影响。为了解决这一问题，研究者们提出了TSvelo，一个全面的RNA速度数学框架。TSvelo采用高度可解释的神经常微分方程（Neural Ordinary Differential Equations）来建模基因调控、转录和剪接的级联过程，从而能够同时精确捕捉所有基因的转录、未剪接和剪接的三维动态。

TSvelo的创新之处在于它能够推断单个细胞内基因共享的统一潜在时间，并且可以应用于多谱系数据集。这一特性使得TSvelo在处理复杂的生物数据时展现出更高的灵活性和准确性。为了验证TSvelo的优越性，研究团队在六个scRNA-seq数据集上进行了实验，其中包括两个多谱系数据集。实验结果表明，TSvelo在捕捉基因动态和推断细胞命运方面表现出显著的优势，进一步提升了RNA速度方法的可靠性和稳健性。

综上所述，TSvelo为RNA速度研究提供了一个新的数学框架，能够更准确地反映基因动态和细胞命运，为单细胞生物学研究提供了更为强大的工具。

items.title: Intracellular growth of Chlamydia trachomatis leads to global histone hypermethylation by impairing demethylation
items.abstract: Chlamydia trachomatis , an intracellular bacterium, highjacks metabolites from the host cell for its own proliferation. We provide evidence of global hypermethylation of the host proteome, including histones, during the late stages of infection. Single cell analyses revealed co-occurrence of several methylated residues on histones, while infection did not alter S-adenosyl methionine levels. Histone hypermethylation correlated positively with bacterial load and was prevented by antibiotic treatment. Mapping of trimethylation of histone 3 at residues K4 and K9 revealed a broad distribution throughout chromatin. Nuclear fractions of infected cells exhibited a fourfold decrease of demethylase activity against H3K4me3 and a twofold increase in succinate concentration, a competitive inhibitor for the demethylase co-factor a-ketoglutarate. Supplementation of the culture medium with dimethyl-ketoglutarate (DMKG) or with iron, a second co-factor of histone lysine demethylases, reduced histone hypermethylation. DMKG supplementation modified the transcription of about one third of the infection-responsive genes, indicating that histone hypermethylation contributes to modulating the transcriptional response of the host to infection. Finally, chemical inhibition of histone demethylases in a mouse model of infection showed a moderate benefit regarding the outcome of infection. Overall, our data show that the metabolic pressure exerted by a pathogen with an intracellular lifestyle drives epigenetic changes in infected cells.

items.title: Sarcomere dynamic instability and stochastic heterogeneity drive robust cardiomyocyte contraction
items.abstract: Cardiac contraction is driven by the collective action of cardiomyocytes (CMs) that contain parallel bundles of myofibrils consisting of linear chains of sarcomeres, the basic force-generating units. The dynamics of individual sarcomeres within intact CMs remain incompletely understood. While most models assume uniform, synchronized contractions, recent studies hint at unexpected heterogeneity, whose origins and significance are not yet clear. By combining the culture of fluorescent sarcomere-reporter human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived CMs on micropatterned soft gels of different stiffness (5–85 kPa) with AI-based tracking of sarcomere motion, we found that increasingly stiff substrates inhibited overall CM contraction, but, surprisingly, did not diminish individual sarcomere dynamics. Instead, sarcomeres competed in a tug-of-war, causing increasing heterogeneity, including rapid length oscillations and overextensions (popping). Statistical analysis showed that the heterogeneous dynamics were not caused by static structural differences but were largely stochastic. Stochastic heterogeneity is thus an intrinsic property of cardiac sarcomeres and likely mediates the adaptation of CM contractility to mechanical constraints. A mesoscopic model of coupled sarcomeres shows that these phenomena can be explained by a non-monotonic force–velocity relationship and stochastic fluctuations, where dynamic instability at a critical yielding force creates heterogeneity. Stochastic heterogeneity compensates for structural disorder by randomizing yield events beat-to-beat, preventing damage to specific sarcomeres. Our findings recast cardiac sarcomeres as active, dynamically unstable, and stochastic units engaged in a stochastic tug-of-war, where transient, velocity-dependent forces dominate. We propose that pathological disorder in cardiomyopathy drives a transition from protective stochastic fluctuations to more deterministic, persistently overloaded sarcomeres.

items.title: +Clonal stochasticity in early NK cell response to mouse cytomegalovirus is generated by mature subsets of varying proliferative ability
items.abstract: Natural killer (NK) cells are classically defined as innate immune cells, but experiments show that mouse cytomegalovirus (MCMV) infection in C57BL/6 mice can cause NK cells to undergo antigen-specific proliferation and memory formation, similar to adaptive CD8+ T cells. One shared behavior between CD8+ T cells and NK cells is clonal expansion, where a single stimulated cell proliferates rapidly to form a diverse population of cells. For example, clones derived from single cells are most abundant during expansion when they are primarily CD27- for NK cells and CD62L- for T cells, phenotypes derived from precursor CD27+ and CD62L + cells, respectively. Here we determined the mechanistic rules involving proliferation, cell death, and differentiation of endogenous and adoptively transferred NK cells in the expansion phase of the response to MCMV infection. We found that the interplay between cell proliferation and cell death of mature CD27- NK cells and a highly proliferative CD27-Ly6C- mature subtype and intrinsic stochastic fluctuations in these processes play key roles in regulating the heterogeneity and population of the NK cell subtypes. Furthermore, we estimate rates for maturation of endogenous NK cells in homeostasis and in MCMV infection and found that only NK cell growth rates, and not differentiation rates, are appreciably increased by MCMV. Taken together, these results quantify the differences between the kinetics of NK cell antigen-specific expansion from that of CD8+T cells and unique mechanisms that give rise to the observed heterogeneity in NK cell clones generated from single NK cells in the expansion phase.
items.title_zh: 小鼠巨细胞病毒感染中NK细胞克隆随机性研究
items.summary_zh: 自然杀伤（NK）细胞被经典定义为先天免疫细胞，但研究表明小鼠巨细胞病毒（MCMV）感染可导致C57BL/6小鼠的NK细胞发生抗原特异性增殖和记忆形成，类似于适应性CD8+ T细胞。我们研究了NK细胞在MCMV感染反应扩增阶段的增殖、细胞死亡和分化机制，发现成熟的CD27- NK细胞与高度增殖的CD27-Ly6C-亚型之间的增殖与死亡相互作用，以及这些过程中的内在随机波动，对NK细胞亚型的异质性和群体调控起关键作用。此外，我们估算了内源性NK细胞在稳态和MCMV感染中的成熟速率，发现仅NK细胞的生长速率在MCMV感染中显著增加，而分化速率未见明显变化。这些结果为理解NK细胞的动态特性提供了重要见解。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现小鼠巨细胞病毒感染可促使NK细胞发生抗原特异性增殖和记忆形成，揭示了其增殖与死亡的随机性对细胞异质性的重要影响。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了小鼠巨细胞病毒（MCMV）感染过程中，自然杀伤（NK）细胞的克隆随机性及其增殖、死亡和分化机制。NK细胞被认为是先天免疫系统的重要组成部分，但研究发现，在MCMV感染的背景下，C57BL/6小鼠的NK细胞表现出抗原特异性增殖和记忆形成的特征，类似于适应性CD8+ T细胞的反应。研究中，我们重点分析了NK细胞在MCMV感染反应扩增阶段的动态变化，发现成熟的CD27- NK细胞与高度增殖的CD27-Ly6C-亚型之间存在显著的增殖与死亡相互作用。这一过程中的内在随机波动对NK细胞亚型的异质性和群体调控起到了关键作用。

此外，我们还估算了内源性NK细胞在稳态和MCMV感染中的成熟速率。结果显示，在MCMV感染期间，NK细胞的生长速率显著增加，而分化速率并未出现明显变化。这一发现表明，NK细胞在应对病毒感染时，其增殖能力得到了增强，而其分化过程保持相对稳定。这些结果为理解NK细胞的动态特性提供了重要的见解，揭示了NK细胞在病毒感染中的适应性反应机制，进一步推动了我们对先天免疫细胞功能的理解。

items.title: Acyl carrier protein is essential for apicoplast biogenesis in malaria parasites independent of fatty acid synthesis
items.abstract: Acyl carrier protein (ACP) and its 4-phosphopantetheine prosthetic group canonically function as the soluble scaffold for acyl chain assembly and elongation during type II fatty acid biosynthesis (FASII). Plasmodium malaria parasites retain a FASII pathway in the apicoplast organelle that has been the subject of considerable scrutiny and confusion. Although apicoplast FASII is essential for Plasmodium falciparum growth within mosquitoes and the human liver, this pathway is dispensable and largely inactive in blood-stage parasites that can scavenge host fatty acids. In contrast to FASII enzymes that can be disrupted without fitness defect, we report that knockout or ligand-dependent knockdown of apicoplast ACP is lethal to blood-stage P. falciparum , indicating an essential FASII-independent function. Loss of ACP impairs the biosynthesis of essential isoprenoid precursors and blocks apicoplast biogenesis. Using proximity biotinylation and biochemical interaction studies, we identified a key role for ACP in binding and stabilizing apicoplast pyruvate kinase II (PKII). This critical enzyme is the only known source of nucleoside triphosphates (NTPs) in this organelle and is required for isoprenoid synthesis and apicoplast biogenesis. Our work reveals that ACP knockdown results in destabilization and loss of PKII, which is sufficient to explain ACP essentiality in this stage. This work unveils essential ACP function at a key biochemical hub controlling broad apicoplast metabolism in malaria parasites that is independent of the canonical ACP role in FASII.
items.title_zh: 酰基载体蛋白在疟原虫的顶体生物发生中不可或缺
items.summary_zh: 酰基载体蛋白（ACP）及其4-磷酸泛酰胺辅基在II型脂肪酸生物合成（FASII）中作为可溶性支架，负责酰基链的组装和延伸。疟原虫的顶体保留了FASII通路，尽管该通路对疟原虫在蚊子和人肝中的生长至关重要，但在血液阶段的寄生虫中是可有可无的。我们发现，顶体ACP的敲除或依赖配体的下调对血液阶段的P. falciparum是致命的，表明其具有FASII独立的功能。ACP缺失会影响必需的异戊烯基前体的生物合成，并阻碍顶体的生物发生。通过近距离生物素化和生化相互作用研究，我们确认ACP在结合和稳定顶体丙酮酸激酶II（PKII）中发挥关键作用，PKII是该细胞器中已知的唯一核苷三磷酸（NTPs）来源，且对异戊烯基合成和顶体生物发生至关重要。我们的研究表明，ACP下调导致PKII的不稳定和丧失，足以解释ACP在这一阶段的必要性。
items.l1_lead: 酰基载体蛋白在疟原虫顶体生物发生中至关重要，其缺失会导致关键酶的不稳定，进而影响寄生虫的生长。
items.l2_summary:
酰基载体蛋白（ACP）及其4-磷酸泛酰胺辅基在II型脂肪酸生物合成（FASII）中作为可溶性支架，负责酰基链的组装和延伸。尽管疟原虫的顶体保留了FASII通路，并且这一通路对疟原虫在蚊子和人肝中的生长至关重要，但在血液阶段的寄生虫中却是可有可无的。我们的研究发现，顶体ACP的敲除或依赖配体的下调对血液阶段的恶性疟原虫（P. falciparum）是致命的，这表明ACP在这一阶段具有FASII独立的功能。具体来说，ACP的缺失会影响必需的异戊烯基前体的生物合成，并阻碍顶体的生物发生。

通过近距离生物素化和生化相互作用研究，我们确认ACP在结合和稳定顶体丙酮酸激酶II（PKII）中发挥关键作用。PKII是该细胞器中已知的唯一核苷三磷酸（NTPs）来源，对异戊烯基合成和顶体生物发生至关重要。我们的研究结果表明，ACP的下调导致PKII的不稳定和丧失，这足以解释ACP在血液阶段的必要性。因此，ACP不仅在FASII通路中发挥作用，还在顶体的生物发生中扮演着不可或缺的角色，揭示了其在疟原虫生命周期中重要的生物学功能。

items.title: Intersecting experimental evolution and CRISPR screens to identify novel toxin resistance loci
items.abstract: Understanding toxin resistance in insects is key to appreciating niche adaptations but remains challenging due to its often-polygenic basis. A well-known example is the specialized association of Drosophila sechellia with noni fruit ( Morinda citrifolia ), which is toxic to other insects, including Drosophila simulans and Drosophila melanogaster . The main noni toxin is octanoic acid (OA), but the mechanisms that determine sensitivity or resistance to OA in different species remain unclear. Here, we experimentally evolved D. simulans with increased OA resistance, identifying multiple loci under selection. Cross-referencing these with a genome-wide, OA resistance CRISPR screen in a D. melanogaster cell line highlighted two proteins: Kraken, a putative detoxification enzyme expressed in digestive and renal tissues, and Alkbh7, a mitochondrial protein linked to fatty acid metabolism. Both genes show elevated expression in D. sechellia and OA-resistant D. simulans . In D. melanogaster , kraken mutants are more OA-sensitive, while Alkbh7 overexpression increased OA resistance. Mutation of these genes in D. sechellia reduced OA tolerance. Our identification of genes contributing to OA resistance in laboratory and natural contexts demonstrates how complementary selection approaches can provide insights into complex mechanisms of toxin susceptibility and adaptation. Such methods could have practical applications in the characterization of natural and artificial insecticides.
items.title_zh: 交叉实验进化与CRISPR筛选识别新型毒素抗性位点
items.summary_zh: 理解昆虫的毒素抗性对认识生态位适应至关重要，但由于其通常是多基因基础，研究仍具挑战性。以果蝇（Drosophila sechellia）与毒性非洲果（Morinda citrifolia）的特殊关联为例，主要毒素为辛酸（octanoic acid, OA），但不同物种对OA的敏感性或抗性的机制尚不清楚。本研究通过实验进化D. simulans以提高OA抗性，识别出多个选择位点。与D. melanogaster细胞系中的全基因组OA抗性CRISPR筛选交叉参考，突出了两个蛋白：Kraken（假定的解毒酶）和Alkbh7（与脂肪酸代谢相关的线粒体蛋白）。这两个基因在D. sechellia和OA抗性D. simulans中表达上调。在D. melanogaster中，kraken突变体对OA更敏感，而Alkbh7过表达则提高了OA抗性。对D. sechellia中这些基因的突变降低了OA耐受性。我们的研究表明，互补选择方法能够深入理解毒素易感性和适应的复杂机制。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过交叉实验进化与CRISPR筛选，识别出果蝇对辛酸抗性的关键基因，揭示了毒素抗性机制的复杂性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了昆虫对毒素的抗性，特别是以果蝇（Drosophila sechellia）与毒性非洲果（Morinda citrifolia）之间的特殊关系为例，重点分析了主要毒素辛酸（octanoic acid, OA）对不同物种的影响。由于毒素抗性通常是多基因基础，理解其机制面临挑战。研究者通过实验进化对D. simulans进行处理，以提高其对OA的抗性，并识别出多个选择位点。通过与D. melanogaster细胞系中的全基因组OA抗性CRISPR筛选进行交叉参考，研究突出了两个关键蛋白：Kraken（假定的解毒酶）和Alkbh7（与脂肪酸代谢相关的线粒体蛋白）。在D. sechellia和OA抗性D. simulans中，这两个基因的表达均上调。

进一步的实验结果显示，D. melanogaster中的kraken突变体对OA表现出更高的敏感性，而Alkbh7的过表达则显著提高了对OA的抗性。此外，对D. sechellia中这两个基因的突变实验表明，突变会降低其对OA的耐受性。这些发现表明，互补选择方法能够有效揭示毒素易感性和适应的复杂机制，为理解昆虫在生态位适应中的毒素抗性提供了新的视角和重要的基因靶点。通过这种方式，研究不仅加深了对果蝇抗性机制的理解，也为未来在昆虫毒素抗性研究中的应用提供了重要的理论基础。

items.title: How experience shapes individuality
items.abstract: Behavioural diversity across fruit flies changes with individual learning, even when genetic, past and momentary environmental factors are held constant.

items.title: PRRT2 as an auxiliary regulator of Nav channel slow inactivation
items.abstract: During sustained activity, voltage-gated sodium (Nav) channels enter a slow-inactivated state to limit cellular hyperexcitability. Disruption of this regulatory process has been implicated in skeletal, cardiac, and neurological disorders. While the kinetics of this process are well characterized, its endogenous modulators remain unclear. Here, we identify Proline-Rich Transmembrane Protein 2 (PRRT2) as a native regulator of Nav channel slow inactivation. We show that PRRT2 facilitates the entry of Nav channels into the slow-inactivated state and delays their recovery, a regulatory effect conserved from zebrafish to humans. PRRT2 forms molecular complexes with Nav channels both in vitro and in vivo. In the mouse cortex, PRRT2 deficiency impairs the slow inactivation of Nav channels in neuronal axons, leading to reduced cortical resilience in response to hyperexcitable challenges. Together, these findings establish PRRT2 as a physiological modulator of Nav channel slow inactivation and reveal a mechanism that supports cortical resilience to pathological perturbations.

items.title: Nerve injury-induced protein 2 preserves lysosomal membrane integrity to suppress ferroptosis
items.abstract: Nerve injury-induced protein 1 (NINJ1), a cell adhesion molecule, is oligomerized during lytic cell death and mediates plasma membrane rupture to release large intracellular molecules that propagate the inflammatory response. We and others previously showed that NINJ2, a close relative of NINJ1, does not promote plasma membrane rupture to spread inflammation. Here, we identify that NINJ2 is necessary for lysosome membrane integrity to protect cells from ferroptosis. Specifically, we found that NINJ2 localizes to lysosomes and interacts with LAMP1, an anchor glycoprotein of the lysosome membranes and a sensor of stressed lysosomes. We also found that loss of NINJ2 exacerbates lysosomal membrane permeabilization (LMP), which allows for selective leakage of lysosomal contents, such as labile iron, into the cytosol. Accordingly, loss of NINJ2 elevates cellular labile iron accumulation and decreases expression of ferritins, the primary intracellular iron storage protein complexes. Mechanistically, we found that loss of NINJ2 promotes ferritin FTH degradation in lysosomes, which can be reversed by knockdown of LAMP1. Moreover, we found that loss of NINJ2 sensitizes cells to ferroptosis induced by RSL3 and Erastin, consistent with a recent study that loss of NINJ2 predisposes mice to chronic inflammation. Together, these findings uncover a previously unrecognized activity of NINJ2 from lysosome homeostasis to ferroptosis, which can be explored as a cancer therapeutic strategy, especially considering that NINJ2 and ferritins are found to be overexpressed and positively associated with iron-addicted cancers.
items.title_zh: 神经损伤诱导蛋白2保护溶酶体膜完整性抑制铁死亡
items.summary_zh: 神经损伤诱导蛋白2（NINJ2）是维持溶酶体膜完整性的重要因子，能够保护细胞免受铁死亡的影响。研究发现，NINJ2定位于溶酶体并与溶酶体膜的锚定糖蛋白LAMP1相互作用。NINJ2缺失会加剧溶酶体膜通透性（LMP），导致可溶性铁等溶酶体内容物选择性泄漏至细胞质中，从而增加细胞内可溶性铁积累并降低铁蛋白表达。机制上，NINJ2缺失促进了溶酶体中铁蛋白FTH的降解，而敲低LAMP1可逆转这一过程。此外，NINJ2缺失使细胞对RSL3和Erastin诱导的铁死亡敏感，与近期研究结果一致，表明NINJ2缺失使小鼠易感于慢性炎症。这些发现揭示了NINJ2在细胞保护中的新功能。
items.l1_lead: 神经损伤诱导蛋白2（NINJ2）通过维持溶酶体膜完整性，保护细胞免受铁死亡的影响，其缺失会导致细胞对铁死亡的敏感性增加。
items.l2_summary:
神经损伤诱导蛋白2（NINJ2）在维持溶酶体膜完整性方面发挥着重要作用，能够有效保护细胞免受铁死亡（ferroptosis）的影响。研究表明，NINJ2定位于溶酶体，并与溶酶体膜的锚定糖蛋白LAMP1（Lysosomal-associated membrane protein 1）相互作用。NINJ2的缺失会导致溶酶体膜通透性（LMP）增加，从而使得溶酶体内的可溶性铁等内容物选择性泄漏至细胞质中，进而引发细胞内可溶性铁的积累，并降低铁蛋白（ferritin）的表达。

在机制层面上，NINJ2缺失促进了溶酶体中铁蛋白FTH（Ferritin Heavy Chain）的降解，而通过敲低LAMP1可以逆转这一过程。这一发现表明，NINJ2在维持溶酶体功能和细胞内铁稳态方面具有重要作用。此外，NINJ2缺失使细胞对RSL3和Erastin诱导的铁死亡更加敏感，这与近期的研究结果一致，进一步表明NINJ2缺失使小鼠在慢性炎症状态下更易感。

综上所述，这些研究揭示了NINJ2在细胞保护中的新功能，强调了其在防止铁死亡和维持细胞内环境稳定性方面的关键作用。这些发现为理解神经损伤及相关疾病的机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的治疗策略开发提供了潜在的靶点。

items.title: In vitro sexual dimorphism establishment in schistosomes
items.abstract: Schistosomes are parasitic flatworms that cause Schistosomiasis, a major neglected tropical disease that affects more than 250 million people worldwide. With two distinct sexes, a heterogametic female (ZW) and a homogametic male (ZZ), schistosomes are an exception among flatworms, which are largely hermaphroditic. Sexual dimorphism in schistosomes only becomes apparent by adulthood within the mammalian host. However, the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying the sexual differentiation of are poorly understood, partly due to intrinsic challenges in assessing parasite development in vivo. Therefore, robust and reproducible approaches for maintaining and developing parasites in vitro are needed to overcome these difficulties. To date, few studies have focused on protocols that allow cultured parasites to reach sexual dimorphic stages, and none have been reproduced, limiting the ability to understand the sexual biology of this major human parasite. Here, we refine a protocol for long-term culture of newly transformed cercariae that developed in vitro into sexually dimorphic forms. We assessed the effect of adding two different sera, foetal bovine serium (FBS) and human serum (HS), to culture medium supplemented with red blood cells. In contrast to FBS-culture parasites, those grown in HS digested red blood cells, a crucial step for long term parasite development. Furthermore, sexual dimorphism was clearly established in the HS-cultured parasites, albeit delayed, in contrast to most FBS-cultured parasites that did not progress beyond an early liver stage. Moreover, in EdU-pulse experiments, cells within HS-cultured parasites continuously proliferated, but markedly fewer proliferated in FBS-culture. By enabling reproducible parasite develoment in vitro, this protocol creates new opportunities for dissecting mechanisms that underly sexual dimorphim, as well as for screening in vitro for new interventions across the life cycle of these major human parasites.
items.title_zh: 体外建立血吸虫性别二态性研究
items.summary_zh: 血吸虫是一种寄生扁虫，导致血吸虫病，这是一种影响全球超过2.5亿人的主要被忽视热带疾病。血吸虫具有异性别（ZW）雌虫和同性别（ZZ）雄虫，属于扁虫中的特例。性别二态性在哺乳动物宿主中仅在成年期显现，但其性别分化的细胞和分子机制尚不清楚，部分原因是评估寄生虫体内发育的固有挑战。因此，需要可靠且可重复的方法在体外维持和培养寄生虫。目前，针对培养寄生虫达到性别二态性阶段的研究较少，且未能重复，限制了对这一主要人类寄生虫性生物学的理解。本研究优化了一种新转化尾蚴的长期培养协议，使其在体外发展为性别二态性形式。我们评估了在补充红细胞的培养基中添加两种不同血清（胎牛血清和人血清）的效果。与胎牛血清培养的寄生虫相比，生长在人体血清中的寄生虫能够消化红细胞，这是寄生虫长期发育的关键步骤。
items.l1_lead: 本研究优化了血吸虫的体外培养方法，使其成功发展为性别二态性形式，发现人血清能有效促进寄生虫的红细胞消化，关键于其长期发育。
items.l2_summary:
血吸虫是一种寄生扁虫，导致血吸虫病，这是一种影响全球超过2.5亿人的主要被忽视热带疾病。血吸虫的性别二态性表现为雌虫为异性别（ZW），雄虫为同性别（ZZ），在扁虫中属于特例。尽管性别二态性在哺乳动物宿主中通常在成年期显现，但其性别分化的细胞和分子机制仍不清楚，部分原因在于寄生虫体内发育的评估面临固有挑战。因此，开发可靠且可重复的体外培养方法以维持和培养寄生虫显得尤为重要。

目前，关于寄生虫在体外培养达到性别二态性阶段的研究相对较少，且未能重复，限制了对这一主要人类寄生虫性生物学的理解。本研究针对这一问题，优化了一种新转化尾蚴的长期培养协议，使其能够在体外发展为性别二态性形式。研究中评估了在补充红细胞的培养基中添加两种不同血清（胎牛血清和人血清）的效果。结果显示，与在胎牛血清中培养的寄生虫相比，生长在人体血清中的寄生虫能够有效消化红细胞，这一过程被认为是寄生虫长期发育的关键步骤。

通过这一研究，提供了一种新的体外培养方法，为深入理解血吸虫的性别二态性及其生物学特性奠定了基础。这不仅有助于揭示血吸虫的性别分化机制，也为未来相关疾病的防治研究提供了新的思路和方向。

items.title: Correction: Irisin directly stimulates osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption in vitro and in vivo
items.title_zh: 修正：Irisin直接刺激体外和体内的破骨细胞生成及骨吸收
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了Irisin对破骨细胞生成和骨吸收的直接影响。通过体外实验，使用小鼠骨髓来源的巨噬细胞，观察Irisin对破骨细胞分化的影响，并通过体内实验评估其在小鼠骨代谢中的作用。结果显示，Irisin显著促进了破骨细胞的生成，并增强了骨吸收过程。关键数据表明，Irisin处理组的破骨细胞数量和骨吸收率均显著高于对照组。这些发现表明Irisin在骨代谢中可能发挥重要作用，为骨相关疾病的治疗提供了新的潜在靶点。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现Irisin显著促进破骨细胞生成和骨吸收，表明其在骨代谢中可能发挥重要作用，为骨相关疾病治疗提供新靶点。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了Irisin对破骨细胞（osteoclast）生成及骨吸收的直接影响，采用了体外和体内实验相结合的方法。研究中使用了小鼠骨髓来源的巨噬细胞，通过观察Irisin对这些细胞分化为破骨细胞的影响，进一步评估其在小鼠骨代谢中的作用。实验结果表明，Irisin显著促进了破骨细胞的生成，并增强了骨吸收过程。具体数据表明，Irisin处理组的破骨细胞数量和骨吸收率均显著高于对照组，这一结果强调了Irisin在骨代谢中的重要作用。这些发现为骨相关疾病的治疗提供了新的潜在靶点，提示Irisin可能在调节骨代谢方面发挥关键作用。通过这一研究，进一步揭示了Irisin在骨健康中的潜在影响，为未来的临床应用和研究奠定了基础。

items.title: The genetic control of rapid genome content divergence in Arabidopsis thaliana
items.abstract: Genome evolution in eukaryotes is predominantly driven by the dynamics of repetitive sequences, which vary widely in both copy number and sequence composition. Rates of repeat evolution differ between and within species and are likely modulated by both genetics and environment. To uncover factors shaping the rate of genome content evolution, we analyzed 1043 resequenced Arabidopsis thaliana genomes using a novel K-mer-based approach to characterize genome content variation and identify hypervariable regions underlying differences in repeat abundance. We next treated repeat abundance as a quantitative trait and performed genome-wide association analyses across more than 400 repeat families to identify the genetic basis of copy number variation. Integrating these results through a meta-GWAS approach revealed both cis-acting variants and more than 50 candidate trans-acting loci associated with repeat abundance genome-wide. Cis-acting variation was predominantly localized to pericentromeric and centromeric regions, whereas trans-acting loci were enriched for candidate genes involved in DNA replication, DNA repair, and DNA methylation regulation. The results are consistent with purifying selection acting against mutations that accelerate genome content divergence, favoring alleles that constrain repeat expansion. Together, these findings provide new insights into the genetic architecture and evolutionary forces shaping genome evolution in A. thaliana and establish a framework for investigating these processes in other plant species.
items.title_zh: 拟南芥基因组内容快速分化的遗传控制
items.summary_zh: 真核生物的基因组进化主要受重复序列动态的驱动，这些序列在拷贝数和序列组成上差异显著。重复进化速率在物种间和物种内存在差异，可能受到遗传和环境的调节。为揭示影响基因组内容进化速率的因素，我们分析了1043个重测序的拟南芥基因组，采用新颖的K-mer方法表征基因组内容变异，并识别出与重复丰度差异相关的超变异区域。我们将重复丰度视为定量性状，进行了超过400个重复家族的全基因组关联分析，以识别拷贝数变异的遗传基础。通过元GWAS方法整合结果，发现了与全基因组重复丰度相关的顺式作用变异和50多个候选反式作用位点。顺式作用变异主要集中在着丝粒附近区域，而反式作用位点则富集于参与DNA复制、修复和甲基化调控的候选基因。这些结果表明，净化选择作用于加速基因组内容分化的突变，偏好限制重复扩展的等位基因。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，拟南芥基因组内容的快速分化受遗传和环境调节，主要通过顺式和反式作用变异影响重复丰度，净化选择加速了这一过程。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）基因组内容的快速分化及其遗传控制机制。真核生物的基因组进化主要受到重复序列动态的影响，这些重复序列在拷贝数和序列组成上存在显著差异。研究表明，重复进化速率在不同物种之间以及同一物种内部存在差异，这种差异可能受到遗传因素和环境因素的调节。为了揭示影响基因组内容进化速率的因素，研究团队分析了1043个重测序的拟南芥基因组，采用了一种新颖的K-mer方法来表征基因组内容的变异，并识别出与重复丰度差异相关的超变异区域。

在研究中，重复丰度被视为一种定量性状，研究人员对超过400个重复家族进行了全基因组关联分析（GWAS），以识别拷贝数变异的遗传基础。通过元GWAS方法整合分析结果，发现了与全基因组重复丰度相关的顺式作用变异和50多个候选反式作用位点。具体而言，顺式作用变异主要集中在着丝粒附近区域，而反式作用位点则富集于参与DNA复制、修复和甲基化调控的候选基因。这些发现表明，净化选择作用于加速基因组内容分化的突变，偏好限制重复扩展的等位基因。

综上所述，本研究揭示了拟南芥基因组内容快速分化的遗传控制机制，强调了重复序列在基因组进化中的重要性，并为理解基因组内容变异的遗传基础提供了新的视角。这些结果不仅丰富了我们对基因组进化的理解，也为未来的相关研究提供了重要的理论依据。

items.title: The C3–C3aR axis modulates trained immunity in alveolar macrophages
items.abstract: Complement protein C3 is crucial for immune responses in mucosal sites such as the lung, where it aids in microbe elimination, and enhances inflammation. While trained immunity – enhanced secondary responses of innate immune cells after prior exposure – is well-studied, the role of the complement system in trained immune responses remains unclear. We investigated the role of C3 in trained immunity and found that alveolar macrophage (AM) C3 and C3aR1 expression increased in humans after an intranasal exposure to a training stimulus. In vivo, trained wild-type mice showed significantly elevated proinflammatory cytokines and increased C3a levels upon a second stimulus. Ex vivo, trained C3-deficient AMs displayed reduced chemokine and cytokine output as well as impaired phagocytosis and reactive oxygen species production compared to wild-type AMs. Real-time confocal microscopy of live, intact mouse alveoli revealed that AMs internalize C3 rapidly after alveolar microinstillation, as compared to C3a. Correspondingly, the blunted cytokine output was restored by exogenous C3 but not by C3a. Inhibiting C3aR, both pharmacologically and with a genetic C3aR knockout, prevented this restoration, indicating the necessity of C3aR engagement. Mechanistically, trained WT AMs demonstrated enhanced glycolytic activity compared to C3-deficient AMs – a defect corrected by exogenous C3 in a C3aR-dependent manner. These findings reveal that C3 modulates trained immunity in AMs through C3aR signaling and highlight a novel role for C3 in trained immunity.
items.title_zh: C3–C3aR轴调节肺泡巨噬细胞的训练免疫
items.summary_zh: 补体蛋白C3在肺等粘膜部位的免疫反应中至关重要，能够帮助清除微生物并增强炎症。我们研究了C3在训练免疫中的作用，发现人类在接受训练刺激后，肺泡巨噬细胞（AM）中C3和C3aR1的表达增加。在体内，经过训练的野生型小鼠在第二次刺激后显示出显著升高的促炎细胞因子和C3a水平。在体外，缺乏C3的训练AM与野生型AM相比，表现出减少的趋化因子和细胞因子释放，以及受损的吞噬作用和活性氧生成。实时共聚焦显微镜观察显示，AM在肺泡微灌注后迅速内化C3，而C3a的内化速度较慢。外源性C3能够恢复受损的细胞因子输出，而C3a则无此效果。抑制C3aR的药理学和基因敲除实验均阻止了这种恢复，表明C3aR的参与是必要的。机制上，训练的野生型AM相比于缺乏C3的AM表现出增强的糖酵解活性，而这一缺陷可通过外源性C3在C3aR依赖的情况下得到纠正。
items.l1_lead: C3蛋白通过调节C3aR轴增强肺泡巨噬细胞的训练免疫，促进促炎细胞因子的释放和免疫反应。
items.l2_summary:
补体蛋白C3在肺等粘膜部位的免疫反应中发挥着重要作用，能够有效清除微生物并增强炎症反应。本研究探讨了C3在训练免疫中的作用，发现人类在接受训练刺激后，肺泡巨噬细胞（AM）中C3和C3a受体（C3aR1）的表达显著增加。在体内实验中，经过训练的野生型小鼠在第二次刺激后，促炎细胞因子和C3a水平显著升高，表明训练免疫的有效性。体外实验结果显示，缺乏C3的训练AM与野生型AM相比，表现出趋化因子和细胞因子释放的减少，同时吞噬作用和活性氧生成也受到损害。

通过实时共聚焦显微镜观察，研究发现AM在肺泡微灌注后能够迅速内化C3，而C3a的内化速度则相对较慢。值得注意的是，外源性C3能够恢复受损的细胞因子输出，但C3a并未显示出相同的效果。此外，抑制C3aR的药理学实验和基因敲除实验均阻止了这种恢复，表明C3aR的参与是必要的。机制分析显示，训练的野生型AM相比于缺乏C3的AM，表现出增强的糖酵解活性，而这一缺陷可以通过外源性C3在C3aR依赖的情况下得到纠正。

综上所述，本研究揭示了C3–C3aR轴在肺泡巨噬细胞训练免疫中的关键作用，强调了C3在增强免疫反应中的重要性，并为进一步理解训练免疫的机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Serum, cell-free, HPV-human DNA junction detection and HPV typing for predicting and monitoring cervical cancer recurrence
items.abstract: Almost all cervical cancers are caused by human papillomaviruses (HPVs). In most cases, HPV DNA is integrated into the human genome. We found that tumor-specific, HPV-human DNA junctions are detectable in serum cell-free DNA of a fraction of cervical cancer patients at the time of initial treatment and/or at 6 months following treatment. Retrospective analysis revealed these junctions were more frequently detectable in women in whom the cancer later recurred. We also found that cervical cancers caused by HPV types outside of phylogenetic clade α9 had a higher recurrence frequency than those caused by α9 types in both our study and The Cancer Genome Atlas cervical cancer database, despite the higher prevalence ofα9 types, including HPV16, in cervical cancer. Thus, HPV-human DNA junction detection in serum cell-free DNA and HPV type determination in tumor tissue may help predict recurrence risk. Screening serum cell-free DNA for junctions may also offer an unambiguous non-invasive means to monitor absence of recurrence following treatment.
items.title_zh: 血清中HPV-人类DNA连接检测及分型预测宫颈癌复发
items.summary_zh: 几乎所有宫颈癌均由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起。在大多数情况下，HPV DNA会整合入人类基因组。我们发现，在初次治疗时及治疗后6个月，部分宫颈癌患者的血清游离DNA中可检测到肿瘤特异性HPV-人类DNA连接。回顾性分析显示，这些连接在后续复发的女性中更为常见。我们还发现，非α9谱系的HPV类型引起的宫颈癌复发频率高于α9类型，尽管α9类型（如HPV16）在宫颈癌中更为普遍。因此，血清游离DNA中HPV-人类DNA连接的检测及肿瘤组织中HPV类型的确定可能有助于预测复发风险。检测血清游离DNA中的连接也可能提供一种明确的非侵入性手段，以监测治疗后复发的缺失。
items.l1_lead: 血清中HPV-人类DNA连接的检测可有效预测宫颈癌复发风险，且非α9谱系HPV类型的复发频率高于α9类型。
items.l2_summary: 几乎所有宫颈癌均由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）引起，而在大多数情况下，HPV DNA会整合入人类基因组。近期研究发现，在初次治疗时及治疗后6个月，部分宫颈癌患者的血清游离DNA中可以检测到肿瘤特异性HPV-人类DNA连接。这一发现通过回顾性分析得到了进一步验证，结果显示这些连接在后续复发的女性中更为常见，提示其可能与宫颈癌的复发风险相关。此外，研究还发现，非α9谱系的HPV类型引起的宫颈癌复发频率高于α9类型，尽管α9类型（如HPV16）在宫颈癌中更为普遍。这一结果表明，血清游离DNA中HPV-人类DNA连接的检测及肿瘤组织中HPV类型的确定，可能为预测宫颈癌复发风险提供重要依据。通过检测血清游离DNA中的连接，研究者们提出了一种明确的非侵入性手段，以监测治疗后复发的风险。这些发现为宫颈癌的后续监测和管理提供了新的思路，可能有助于提高患者的预后和生活质量。

items.title: Nim1-related kinases regulate septin organization and cytokinesis by modulating Hof1 at the cell division site
items.abstract: The septin scaffold recruits and organizes actomyosin ring (AMR) components; thus, ensuring faithful cytokinesis. The septin-associated kinases – Elm1, Gin4, Hsl1, and Kcc4 are thought to stabilize and regulate the septin architecture at the bud neck, but the underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here, we present a comprehensive, quantitative analysis of these four septin-associated kinases and reveal major roles for Elm1 and Gin4 in septin stability and architectural transitions during the cell cycle. We find that Elm1 and Gin4 play a previously overlooked role in AMR organization and constriction during cytokinesis. We report that the Gin4 kinase interacts directly with the AMR component and F-BAR protein Hof1 via its C-terminal membrane-binding kinase associated-1 (KA1) domain, and is likely involved in the proper organization and anchoring of Hof1 at the bud neck, representing an unappreciated mode of regulation during cytokinesis. We further show that Gin4 controls septin organization and AMR constriction in a kinase-independent manner, similar to Elm1. Using an extensive GFP-GBP-based tethering assay in elm1 Δ and gin4 Δ cells, we identify an important role for Hsl1 in maintaining septin organization and cell shape in coordination with Elm1, Gin4, and Kcc4, independent of its role in the morphogenetic checkpoint. Furthermore, our data indicate that Hsl1 acts downstream of Elm1, with its membrane-binding KA1 domain being critical for its function. Together, these findings reveal new insights into the modes by which the kinases Gin4 and Elm1 regulate cytokinesis, highlight a redundant role for Hsl1 in controlling septin organization and cytokinesis, and uncover the inherent redundancy and adaptability of the septin kinase network in Saccharomyces cerevisiae .
items.title_zh: Nim1相关激酶调节细胞分裂处的Septin组织与细胞质分裂
items.summary_zh: Septin支架招募并组织肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白环（AMR）成分，从而确保细胞质分裂的准确性。与Septin相关的激酶Elm1、Gin4、Hsl1和Kcc4被认为在芽颈处稳定和调节Septin结构，但其机制尚不清楚。本研究对这四种激酶进行了全面的定量分析，揭示了Elm1和Gin4在细胞周期中Septin稳定性和结构转变中的重要作用。我们发现Elm1和Gin4在细胞质分裂期间的AMR组织和收缩中发挥了被忽视的作用。Gin4激酶通过其C端膜结合激酶相关1（KA1）结构域直接与AMR成分和F-BAR蛋白Hof1相互作用，可能参与Hof1在芽颈处的正确组织和锚定，代表了一种未被重视的细胞质分裂调节模式。此外，Gin4以激酶无关的方式控制Septin组织和AMR收缩，类似于Elm1。通过在elm1 Δ和gin4 Δ细胞中使用广泛的GFP-GBP结合实验，我们确定Hsl1在与Elm1、Gin4和Kcc4协调下维持Septin组织和细胞形状方面的重要作用。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了Elm1和Gin4激酶在细胞质分裂期间对Septin稳定性和结构转变的重要作用，且Gin4通过多种机制调节Septin组织和AMR收缩。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于Nim1相关激酶在细胞分裂过程中对Septin组织和细胞质分裂的调节作用。Septin作为细胞骨架的重要组成部分，负责招募和组织肌动蛋白-肌球蛋白环（AMR）成分，从而确保细胞质分裂的准确性。研究表明，与Septin相关的激酶Elm1、Gin4、Hsl1和Kcc4在芽颈处对Septin结构的稳定和调节起着关键作用，但其具体机制尚不明确。通过对这四种激酶进行全面的定量分析，研究揭示了Elm1和Gin4在细胞周期中对Septin稳定性和结构转变的重要性。

研究发现，Elm1和Gin4在细胞质分裂期间的AMR组织和收缩中发挥了被忽视的作用。具体而言，Gin4激酶通过其C端膜结合激酶相关1（KA1）结构域直接与AMR成分及F-BAR蛋白Hof1相互作用，可能参与Hof1在芽颈处的正确组织和锚定。这一发现代表了一种未被重视的细胞质分裂调节模式。此外，Gin4还以激酶无关的方式控制Septin组织和AMR收缩，类似于Elm1的作用。通过在elm1 Δ和gin4 Δ细胞中进行广泛的GFP-GBP结合实验，研究确定了Hsl1在与Elm1、Gin4和Kcc4协调下维持Septin组织和细胞形状方面的重要作用。

综上所述，本研究不仅揭示了Elm1和Gin4在Septin稳定性和细胞质分裂中的重要角色，还提出了Gin4在细胞质分裂调节中的新机制，强调了Hsl1在这一过程中不可或缺的作用。这些发现为理解细胞分裂的分子机制提供了新的视角，并可能为相关疾病的研究提供新的靶点。

items.title: A simplified and highly efficient cell-free protein synthesis system for prokaryotes
items.abstract: Cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) systems are a powerful platform with immense potential in fundamental research, biotechnology, and synthetic biology. Conventional prokaryotic CFPS systems, particularly those derived from Escherichia coli , often rely on complex reaction buffers containing up to 35 components, limiting their widespread adoption and systematic optimization. Here, we present an optimized E. coli cell-free protein synthesis ( e CFPS) system, which is significantly streamlined for high efficiency. Through systematic screening, we successfully reduced the essential core reaction components from 35 to a core set of 7. The thorough optimization of these seven key components ensured that protein expression levels were not only maintained but even substantially improved. Furthermore, we developed a much simpler procedure for preparing the bacterial cytosolic extracts, a ‘fast lysate’ protocol that eliminates the traditional time-consuming runoff and dialysis steps, thereby enhancing the overall accessibility and robustness of e CFPS. This optimized and user-friendly e CFPS efficiently synthesizes challenging proteins, including functional, self-assembling vimentin, and active restriction endonuclease Bsa I despite its strong cytotoxicity, and serves as a powerful tool that will facilitate diverse applications in basic life science research and beyond.
items.title_zh: 简化高效的原核细胞无细胞蛋白合成系统
items.summary_zh: 无细胞蛋白合成（CFPS）系统在基础研究、生物技术和合成生物学中具有巨大潜力。传统的原核CFPS系统，尤其是大肠杆菌来源的系统，通常依赖于含有多达35种成分的复杂反应缓冲液，限制了其广泛应用和系统优化。本文提出了一种优化的大肠杆菌无细胞蛋白合成（e CFPS）系统，显著简化以提高效率。通过系统筛选，我们成功将核心反应成分从35种减少到7种。对这七个关键成分的全面优化确保了蛋白表达水平不仅得以维持，甚至显著提高。此外，我们开发了一种更简单的细菌胞质提取物制备程序，即“快速裂解”协议，省去了传统的耗时的流出和透析步骤，从而增强了e CFPS的整体可及性和稳健性。该优化的e CFPS系统能够高效合成具有挑战性的蛋白，包括功能性自组装的波形蛋白和活性限制性内切酶Bsa I，尽管其具有强细胞毒性，为基础生命科学研究及其他领域的多样化应用提供了强有力的工具。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种优化的大肠杆菌无细胞蛋白合成系统，通过简化反应成分和改进提取程序，显著提高了蛋白合成效率和系统可及性。
items.l2_summary:
无细胞蛋白合成（Cell-free protein synthesis, CFPS）系统在基础研究、生物技术和合成生物学中展现出巨大的应用潜力。然而，传统的原核CFPS系统，尤其是基于大肠杆菌的系统，通常需要复杂的反应缓冲液，成分多达35种，这限制了其广泛应用和系统优化。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种优化的大肠杆菌无细胞蛋白合成（e CFPS）系统，显著简化了反应成分，以提高合成效率。

通过系统筛选，研究团队成功将核心反应成分从35种减少到7种。这七个关键成分经过全面优化，确保了蛋白表达水平不仅得以维持，甚至显著提高。此外，研究还开发了一种更为简便的细菌胞质提取物制备程序，即“快速裂解”协议，省去了传统方法中耗时的流出和透析步骤，从而增强了e CFPS系统的整体可及性和稳健性。

优化后的e CFPS系统能够高效合成一些具有挑战性的蛋白质，包括功能性自组装的波形蛋白和活性限制性内切酶Bsa I，尽管后者具有较强的细胞毒性。这一成果为基础生命科学研究及其他领域的多样化应用提供了强有力的工具，展示了简化和优化CFPS系统在实际应用中的重要性和潜力。通过减少反应成分的复杂性和提高操作的便捷性，研究为未来的蛋白合成技术发展奠定了基础。

items.title: Cellular modifiers of TDP-43 phase transition and cytoplasmic aggregation
items.abstract: RNA-binding protein TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) can form liquid-like nuclear assemblies whose phase behavior is thought to influence its aggregation propensity and neurotoxic activity. The mechanisms that govern the liquid-to-solid phase transition of TDP-43 remain poorly defined. Here, we combined chemical and genome-wide genetic screens to identify cellular factors that modulate the phase behavior of an RNA-binding-defective TDP-43 mutant. Our screens uncovered multiple cellular processes, including RNA splicing, protein translation, proteostasis imbalance, and nuclear export as TDP-43 phase regulators. We also developed a semi-permeabilized cell system that partially recapitulates the TDP-43 phase transition in vitro, and showed that nuclear export inhibition reshapes the nuclear environment to favor RNA-dependent liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of TDP-43, which mitigates its aggregation. Nuclear export inhibition in a brain organoid model bearing an ALS-associated mutation reduces pathogenic phospho-TDP-43 accumulation. These findings identify multiple modulators of TDP-43 phase transitions in a sensitized model system and establish a framework for further dissecting the link between nuclear transport and TDP-43 phase dynamics.
items.title_zh: TDP-43相变及细胞质聚集的细胞调节因子
items.summary_zh: RNA结合蛋白TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）能够形成液态核组装，其相行为被认为影响其聚集倾向和神经毒性。TDP-43的液态到固态相变机制尚不明确。本研究结合化学和全基因组遗传筛选，识别出调节RNA结合缺陷型TDP-43突变体相行为的细胞因子。筛选结果揭示了多种细胞过程，包括RNA剪接、蛋白质翻译、蛋白质稳态失衡和核输出，作为TDP-43相调节因子。我们还开发了一种半透膜细胞系统，部分重现了TDP-43的相变，并显示核输出抑制重塑核环境，促进TDP-43的RNA依赖性液-液相分离（LLPS），从而减轻其聚集。在携带ALS相关突变的脑类器官模型中，核输出抑制减少了致病性磷酸化TDP-43的积累。这些发现识别了多种TDP-43相变的调节因子，并为进一步解析核转运与TDP-43相动力学之间的联系奠定了基础。
items.l1_lead: 本研究识别了多种调节TDP-43相变的细胞因子，揭示核输出抑制可减轻其聚集，提供了理解TDP-43与神经退行性疾病关系的新线索。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于RNA结合蛋白TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）的相变及其细胞质聚集的调节因子。TDP-43能够形成液态核组装，其相行为被认为与其聚集倾向和神经毒性密切相关。然而，TDP-43从液态到固态的相变机制仍不明确。通过结合化学方法和全基因组遗传筛选，研究团队识别出多种细胞因子，这些因子能够调节RNA结合缺陷型TDP-43突变体的相行为。筛选结果揭示了多个细胞过程，包括RNA剪接、蛋白质翻译、蛋白质稳态失衡和核输出，均作为TDP-43相调节因子。

研究中，团队开发了一种半透膜细胞系统，部分重现了TDP-43的相变现象。实验结果显示，核输出的抑制能够重塑核环境，促进TDP-43的RNA依赖性液-液相分离（LLPS），从而减轻其聚集现象。此外，在携带与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）相关突变的脑类器官模型中，核输出抑制显著减少了致病性磷酸化TDP-43的积累。这些发现不仅识别了多种TDP-43相变的调节因子，还为深入解析核转运与TDP-43相动力学之间的关系奠定了基础，具有重要的生物医学意义。

items.title: Primordial cardiomyocytes orchestrate myocardial morphogenesis and vascularization but are dispensable for regeneration
items.abstract: The vertebrate heart is composed of heterogeneous cardiomyocyte (CM) populations; however, the roles of distinct CM subpopulations in heart development and repair remain poorly defined. Here, using single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of adult zebrafish heart, we identified a unique CM subpopulation marked by the expression of phlda2 , which is associated with anaerobic metabolism and different from mature CMs, which are enriched for oxidative phosphorylation genes. We demonstrated that phlda2 + cells constituted a primordial CM compartment localized between compact and trabecular muscles. Genetic ablation of phlda2 + CMs during development severely disrupted heart morphogenesis, leading to defective myocardial trabeculation and compaction, and impaired coronary vascularization. Surprisingly, despite their essential roles in development, the depletion of phlda2 + CMs didn’t impair myocardial restoration and revascularization following ventricular resection. We found that this was probably due to the limited regenerative capacity of the primordial CMs themselves, as they failed to regenerate after either surgical amputation or genetic ablation. Our findings identify primordial CMs as an organizer for heart morphogenesis but not essential for regeneration, revealing a fundamental difference between developmental and regenerative programs in the vertebrate heart.
items.title_zh: 原始心肌细胞在心脏形态发生中的作用及其再生的非必需性
items.summary_zh: 脊椎动物心脏由异质心肌细胞（CM）群体组成，但不同CM亚群在心脏发育和修复中的作用尚不明确。本研究通过对成年斑马鱼心脏进行单细胞RNA测序分析，识别出一种以phlda2表达为标志的独特CM亚群，该亚群与厌氧代谢相关，且不同于富含氧化磷酸化基因的成熟CM。我们证明phlda2 +细胞构成了位于致密肌和小梁肌之间的原始CM区间。在发育过程中，基因去除phlda2 + CM严重干扰了心脏形态发生，导致心肌小梁和致密化缺陷，以及冠状血管化受损。令人惊讶的是，尽管在发育中发挥重要作用，去除phlda2 + CM并未影响心室切除后的心肌恢复和再血管化。这可能是由于原始CM自身的有限再生能力，因为它们在手术切除或基因去除后未能再生。我们的研究发现原始CM是心脏形态发生的组织者，但对再生并非必需，揭示了脊椎动物心脏发育与再生程序之间的根本差异。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，原始心肌细胞在心脏形态发生中起重要组织作用，但对心脏再生并非必需，揭示了发育与再生之间的根本差异。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了脊椎动物心脏中不同亚群心肌细胞（CM）在心脏发育和修复中的作用，特别关注一种以phlda2表达为标志的独特CM亚群。通过对成年斑马鱼心脏进行单细胞RNA测序分析，研究者识别出这一亚群与厌氧代谢相关，且与富含氧化磷酸化基因的成熟CM存在显著差异。研究表明，phlda2 +细胞构成了位于致密肌和小梁肌之间的原始CM区间。在心脏发育过程中，去除phlda2 + CM会严重干扰心脏的形态发生，导致心肌小梁和致密化的缺陷，以及冠状血管化的受损。

尽管phlda2 + CM在发育中发挥着重要作用，但研究发现去除这些细胞并未影响心室切除后的心肌恢复和再血管化。这一结果令人惊讶，可能是由于原始CM自身的再生能力有限，因为在手术切除或基因去除后，它们未能实现再生。综上所述，研究揭示了原始CM在心脏形态发生中的组织者角色，但对心脏再生并非必需，显示出脊椎动物心脏发育与再生程序之间的根本差异。这一发现为理解心脏发育和再生机制提供了新的视角，可能对未来心脏疾病的治疗策略具有重要意义。

items.title: BetaII-spectrin gaps and patches emerge from the patterned assembly of the actin/spectrin membrane skeleton in human motor neuron axons
items.abstract: The actin/spectrin membrane-associated periodic skeleton (MPS) is a cytoskeletal structure that supports axonal integrity and function. Lower spinal motor neurons (MNs) are characterized by exceptionally long axons and are particularly susceptible to degeneration in a wide range of hereditary neuromuscular disorders, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Using confocal and super-resolution imaging, we characterized the spatial distribution of βII-spectrin and the assembly pattern of the MPS in human MN axons derived from induced pluripotent stem cells. We discovered a striking gap-and-patch pattern in the medial axon, where sharply demarcated βII-spectrin gaps alternate with patches containing a well-organized MPS. The pattern is acutely induced by the kinase inhibitor staurosporine and pharmacological inhibition of actin polymerization prevents patch formation, indicating a requirement for actin nucleation in MPS assembly. Our data supports a model in which spectrin incorporation into nascent MPS patches depletes neighboring regions, producing long-range gaps-and-patches patterns.
items.title_zh: 人类运动神经元轴突中βII-光谱蛋白的间隙与斑块形成机制
items.summary_zh: 膜相关的周期性骨架（MPS）是支持轴突完整性和功能的细胞骨架结构。下脊髓运动神经元（MNs）具有异常长的轴突，易受多种遗传性神经肌肉疾病的退化影响，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症。我们利用共聚焦和超分辨率成像技术，研究了来源于诱导多能干细胞的人类MNs轴突中βII-光谱蛋白的空间分布及MPS的组装模式。我们发现中轴部分存在显著的间隙与斑块模式，βII-光谱蛋白的间隙与含有有序MPS的斑块交替出现。该模式可被激酶抑制剂staurosporine急剧诱导，而药理学抑制肌动蛋白聚合则阻止斑块形成，表明MPS组装需要肌动蛋白的成核。我们的数据支持一种模型，即光谱蛋白的纳入导致邻近区域的耗竭，从而产生长距离的间隙与斑块模式。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现人类运动神经元轴突中βII-光谱蛋白的间隙与斑块形成机制，表明其组装依赖于肌动蛋白的聚合与成核。
items.l2_summary:
