本研究聚焦于人类下脊髓运动神经元（MNs）轴突中βII-光谱蛋白（βII-spectrin）的空间分布及其与膜相关的周期性骨架（MPS）组装模式的关系。运动神经元的轴突异常长，易受遗传性神经肌肉疾病的影响，尤其是肌萎缩侧索硬化症。通过共聚焦和超分辨率成像技术，研究团队观察到在MNs轴突的中轴部分存在显著的间隙与斑块交替模式，βII-光谱蛋白的分布呈现出这种特征。具体而言，研究发现βII-光谱蛋白的间隙与含有有序MPS的斑块交替出现，表明其在轴突结构中的重要性。

进一步的实验表明，使用激酶抑制剂staurosporine可以显著诱导这种间隙与斑块的形成，而通过药理学手段抑制肌动蛋白聚合则能够阻止斑块的形成。这一发现提示MPS的组装过程依赖于肌动蛋白的成核，强调了肌动蛋白在维持轴突结构完整性中的关键作用。研究结果支持了一种模型，即光谱蛋白的纳入导致邻近区域的耗竭，从而形成长距离的间隙与斑块模式。这一机制可能为理解运动神经元的轴突退化提供新的视角，并为相关疾病的治疗策略开发提供理论基础。

items.title: Cortical layer 6b mediates state-dependent changes in brain activity and effects of orexin on waking and sleep
items.abstract: One of the most distinctive features of the mammalian cerebral cortex is its laminar structure. Of all cortical layers, layer 6b (L6b) is by far the least studied, despite exhibiting direct sensitivity to orexin and having widespread connectivity, suggesting an important role in regulating cortical oscillations and brain state. We performed chronic electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings in mice in which a subset of L6b neurons was conditionally ‘silenced’, during undisturbed conditions, after sleep deprivation (SD), and after intracerebroventricular (ICV) administration of orexin. While the total amount of waking and sleep or the response to SD were not altered, L6b-silenced mice showed a slowing of theta frequency (6–9 Hz) during wake and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, and a marked reduction of total EEG power, especially in non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep. The infusion of orexin A increased wakefulness in both genotypes, but subsequent levels of EEG slow-wave activity during NREM sleep were lower in L6b-silenced animals in the occipital derivation. In summary, these results demonstrate a role for cortical L6b in state-dependent brain oscillations and in the response to orexinergic neurotransmission. Our findings provide new insights in functions of L6b neurons and could inform the understanding of abnormal regulation of brain states in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders.
items.title_zh: 皮层6b层介导脑活动的状态依赖性变化及食欲素对清醒与睡眠的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了小鼠皮层6b层（L6b）在脑状态调节中的作用。我们对条件性“沉默”的L6b神经元进行慢性脑电图（EEG）记录，比较了未干扰条件、睡眠剥夺（SD）后及脑室内注射食欲素后的情况。结果显示，尽管清醒和睡眠的总时长未改变，L6b沉默小鼠在清醒和快速眼动（REM）睡眠期间的θ频率（6-9 Hz）减慢，非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠的EEG总功率显著降低。食欲素A的注射增加了两种基因型的小鼠清醒状态，但L6b沉默动物在NREM睡眠期间的EEG慢波活动水平较低。综上所述，L6b在状态依赖性脑振荡及对食欲素神经递质的反应中发挥重要作用，为理解神经发育和精神疾病中脑状态的异常调节提供了新见解。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了小鼠皮层6b层在脑状态调节中的关键作用，食欲素对清醒与睡眠的影响及其在神经发育和精神疾病中的潜在意义。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了小鼠皮层6b层（L6b）在脑状态调节中的作用，特别关注其对清醒与睡眠状态的影响。研究中，研究者对条件性“沉默”的L6b神经元进行了慢性脑电图（EEG）记录，比较了在未干扰条件、睡眠剥夺（SD）后以及脑室内注射食欲素（orexin）后的脑活动情况。结果显示，尽管清醒和睡眠的总时长没有显著变化，L6b沉默小鼠在清醒和快速眼动（REM）睡眠期间的θ频率（6-9 Hz）出现减慢现象，而在非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠期间，EEG的总功率显著降低。这表明L6b在调节不同脑状态下的振荡活动中起着重要作用。

此外，食欲素A的注射显著增加了两种基因型小鼠的清醒状态，但在NREM睡眠期间，L6b沉默动物的EEG慢波活动水平却较低。这一发现提示，L6b不仅在状态依赖性脑振荡中发挥作用，还对食欲素神经递质的反应存在差异。综上所述，L6b在脑状态的调节及其对食欲素的反应中扮演着关键角色，为理解神经发育和精神疾病中脑状态的异常调节提供了新的见解。

items.title: Small mammalian herbivores at moderate densities facilitate livestock growth by improving vegetation composition in grasslands
items.abstract: Small mammals and large herbivores have co-evolved in grasslands for millions of years, yet how they interact remains unclear. Although large herbivores can significantly affect the smaller ones, the reverse effect is largely unknown. On the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau, plateau pikas ( Ochotona curzoniae ) are often considered pests that compete with livestock at high densities. Using field experiments, we show that the presence of pikas facilitates weight gains of yaks ( Bos grunniens ) by improving vegetation composition at a moderate density level. Compared to the pika-present treatment, pika removal dramatically increased cover of the poisonous Stellera forbs by twofold, reducing the abundance and protein content of palatable grasses and sedges, yak foraging efficiency, and yak weight gain by up to 42%. Notably, we found a humped relationship between yak weight gains and pika burrow densities in the pika-present plots; the facilitative effect of pikas on yaks was highest at about 200 burrows/ha, but shifted to a competitive effect at pika densities exceeding 400 burrows/ha. These results provide the first empirical evidence that maintaining a moderate density of small mammalian herbivores can benefit growth performance of livestock by improving vegetation composition. Our study highlights the significance of moderate populations of ecosystem-engineering small mammals in sustaining pastoral productivity in rangelands.

items.title: Centrosome migration and apical membrane formation during epithelial polarization in MDCK cysts
items.abstract: Polarization is crucial for the proper functioning of epithelial cells. Early hallmarks include the trafficking and enrichment of polarity molecules to form the apical membrane (AM) or cell–cell junctions, and the apical positioning of the centrosome. However, the dependencies among polarity molecules, AM formation, and centrosome positioning remain poorly understood. When cultured in Matrigel, de novo polarization of a single epithelial cell is often coupled with cytokinesis. During mitotic exit, centrosomes move to the future AM site, raising questions about their role in polarization. We perturbed centrosomes and polarity regulators in Matrigel-cultured cells and manipulated polarity direction using suspension culture to examine the relationships among polarization features. Surprisingly, centrosomal microtubules may not be necessary for centrosome positioning or AM formation, but their absence reduces the efficiency of AM formation. The polarity regulator Par3, rather than AM component trafficking, influences centrosome positioning. In suspension culture, centrosomes migrate in the direction opposite to AM formation. Taken together, our findings define the hierarchical relationships among several polarization features and show that centrosome-based polarity is not universal in epithelial cells, providing new insights into the mechanisms of epithelial polarization.
items.title_zh: MDCK囊泡上皮极性化中的中心体迁移与顶膜形成
items.summary_zh: 上皮细胞的极性化对其正常功能至关重要。早期特征包括极性分子的运输和富集以形成顶膜（AM）或细胞间连接，以及中心体的顶端定位。然而，极性分子、AM形成和中心体定位之间的依赖关系仍不清楚。在Matrigel中培养时，单个上皮细胞的去新极性化通常与细胞分裂相关。在有丝分裂退出期间，中心体移动到未来的AM位置，这引发了它们在极性化中的作用的疑问。我们在Matrigel培养的细胞中扰动中心体和极性调节因子，并通过悬浮培养操控极性方向，以研究极性特征之间的关系。令人惊讶的是，中心体微管可能并不必要用于中心体定位或AM形成，但其缺失会降低AM形成的效率。极性调节因子Par3影响中心体定位，而非AM组分的运输。在悬浮培养中，中心体向与AM形成相反的方向迁移。综合来看，我们的研究定义了多个极性特征之间的层级关系，并表明基于中心体的极性在上皮细胞中并非普遍存在，为上皮极性化机制提供了新见解。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，中心体在上皮细胞极性化中的作用并非普遍存在，其定位与顶膜形成之间的关系复杂，且极性调节因子Par3影响中心体定位。
items.l2_summary:
上皮细胞的极性化是其正常功能的重要基础，涉及极性分子的运输和富集，形成顶膜（apical membrane, AM）和细胞间连接，以及中心体（centrosome）的定位。尽管这些过程在上皮细胞的极性化中扮演着关键角色，但极性分子、AM形成与中心体定位之间的依赖关系尚不明确。在Matrigel中培养的单个上皮细胞中，去新极性化通常与细胞分裂相关。在有丝分裂退出期间，中心体会移动到未来的AM位置，这引发了对其在极性化中作用的进一步探讨。

为了解极性特征之间的关系，研究者对Matrigel培养的细胞进行了中心体和极性调节因子的扰动，并通过悬浮培养操控极性方向。研究结果显示，中心体微管可能并不必要用于中心体的定位或AM的形成，但其缺失会显著降低AM形成的效率。此外，极性调节因子Par3对中心体的定位有影响，但并不影响AM组分的运输。在悬浮培养中，中心体向与AM形成相反的方向迁移，这一发现进一步揭示了极性特征之间的复杂关系。

综合来看，这项研究明确了多个极性特征之间的层级关系，并提出基于中心体的极性在上皮细胞中并非普遍存在的观点，为理解上皮极性化机制提供了新的见解。这些发现不仅为细胞生物学领域的研究提供了重要的理论基础，也可能对相关疾病的治疗策略开发产生影响。

items.title: Slap restricts oncogenic Src-family kinase signaling to maintain colonic epithelial homeostasis
items.abstract: Src-family kinases (SFKs) regulate proliferation in colonic epithelial cells (CECs), but the mechanisms that restrain their activity remain poorly defined. We identify Src-like adaptor protein (SLAP), a negative regulator of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling, as a key suppressor of SFK activity in the colon. Constitutive and inducible epithelial-specific Slap deletion using a villin-CreERT2 model increases CEC proliferation and accelerates tumorigenesis in the azoxymethane/dextran sodium sulfate model. Slap deficiency also enhances SFK-dependent expansion of normal and tumor-derived colonic organoids. Mechanistically, we identify the receptor tyrosine kinase EPHB2 as a critical upstream activator of SFKs and a direct target of SLAP-mediated regulation. Loss of Slap increased EphB2 protein abundance and tyrosine phosphorylation, and enhanced its association with active SRC. Pharmacological inhibition of EPHB2 suppressed SRC activation and reversed the hyperproliferative phenotype induced by Slap deficiency. Together, these findings uncover a non-genetic mechanism driving SFK activation during colonic transformation and establish SLAP as a tumor suppressor that constrains oncogenic EPHB2–SFK signaling in the colonic epithelium.

items.title: Preserved cerebellar functions despite structural degeneration in older adults
items.abstract: Aging is frequently perceived negatively due to its association with declines in brain and motor function yet not all aspects of brain function are equally affected. The cerebellum, a brain region closely linked to motor control, undergoes clear structural changes with age, but the impact of this degeneration on cerebellar function remains debated. The present study thoroughly investigates the impact of age on cerebellar function by measuring cerebellar motor and cognitive performance across the lifespan in 50 young adults (20–35 years), 80 older adults (55–70 years), and 30 older-old adults (over 80 years). Participants completed a test battery comprising seven motor control tasks and one cognitive task each designed to probe both cerebellar-specific and general sensorimotor function. Our results revealed that, despite age-related changes in cerebellar structure, cerebellar-specific functions remained intact in older adults compared to young adults, even among those above 80 years old. In contrast, general sensorimotor measures showed a clear pattern of decline with age. Together, these findings indicate that cerebellar function is largely preserved despite pronounced structural degeneration, providing compelling evidence for the cerebellum’s remarkable functional resilience.
items.title_zh: 尽管结构退化，老年人小脑功能依然保持
items.summary_zh: 衰老常被负面看待，因其与大脑和运动功能的下降相关，但并非所有大脑功能都受到同等影响。本研究通过对50名年轻成人（20-35岁）、80名老年成人（55-70岁）和30名高龄老年人（80岁以上）进行小脑运动和认知表现的测量，深入探讨了年龄对小脑功能的影响。参与者完成了包括七个运动控制任务和一个认知任务的测试，旨在探测小脑特异性和一般感觉运动功能。结果显示，尽管小脑结构存在与年龄相关的变化，但与年轻成人相比，老年人的小脑特异性功能保持完好，甚至在80岁以上的人群中亦是如此。相反，一般感觉运动测量则显示出明显的随年龄下降的趋势。这些发现表明，尽管结构明显退化，小脑功能在很大程度上得以保留，提供了小脑显著功能韧性的有力证据。
items.l1_lead: 尽管小脑结构随年龄退化，老年人的小脑特异性功能仍保持良好，显示出其显著的功能韧性。
items.l2_summary:
衰老通常被视为一种负面现象，常常与大脑和运动功能的下降相关。然而，最新研究表明，老年人的小脑（cerebellum）功能并未受到与年龄相关的结构退化的显著影响。该研究对50名年轻成人（20-35岁）、80名老年成人（55-70岁）和30名高龄老年人（80岁以上）进行了小脑运动和认知表现的测量，旨在探讨年龄对小脑功能的影响。参与者完成了包括七个运动控制任务和一个认知任务的测试，以评估小脑特异性功能和一般感觉运动功能。

研究结果显示，尽管小脑结构在老年人中存在与年龄相关的变化，但与年轻成人相比，老年人的小脑特异性功能保持良好，甚至在80岁以上的高龄老年人群体中也同样如此。这一发现表明，老年人的小脑在特定功能上展现出显著的韧性，能够在结构退化的情况下维持其功能表现。相对而言，一般感觉运动测量则显示出明显的随年龄下降的趋势，进一步强调了小脑功能的特殊性。

这些结果为小脑在老年人中的功能韧性提供了有力证据，挑战了传统对衰老的负面看法，提示我们在理解衰老过程时，应更加关注大脑不同区域的功能保留情况。总的来说，尽管老年人的小脑结构可能会退化，但其特定功能的保持为老年人群体的运动和认知能力提供了希望。

items.title: Trpv4 links environmental temperature to testicular differentiation in hermaphroditic ricefield eel
items.abstract: The ricefield eel ( Monopterus albus ), an economically important aquaculture species in China, is a freshwater teleost fish that exhibits protogynous hermaphroditism. Although progress has been made in understanding the sex determination and differentiation of this species, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we show that warm temperature promotes gonadal transformation by up-regulating testicular differentiation genes, such as dmrt1 / sox9a in ovaries. Trpv4, a Ca 2+ -permeable cation channel expressed in gonadal somatic cells, is highly sensitive to ambient temperature and links environmental temperature to testicular differentiation in ricefield eel. In female fish reared at cool temperature, injection of Trpv4 agonist into the ovaries leads to a significant upregulation of male pathway genes and in female fish exposed to warm temperature, Trpv4 inhibition or trpv4 siRNA knockdown suppresses warm temperature-induced male gene expression. pStat3 signaling is downstream of Trpv4 and transduces Trpv4-controlled calcium signaling into the sex determination cascades. Inhibition of pStat3 activity prevents the up-regulation of testicular differentiation genes by warm temperature treatment and ovarian injection of Trpv4 agonist, whereas activation of pStat3 is sufficient to induce the expression of male genes in the presence of Trpv4 antagonist. pStat3 binds and activates jmjd3 / kdm6b , an activator of the dmrt1 gene. Consistently, ovarian injection of Kdm6b inhibitor blocks the up-regulation of testicular differentiation genes by warm temperature exposure. We propose that environmental factors, such as temperature, promote gonadal transformation of ricefield eel by inducing the expression of male pathway genes in ovaries via the Trpv4-pStat3-Kdm6b- dmrt1 axis. Our results provide new insights into the molecular mechanism underlying natural sex change of ricefield eel, which will be useful for sex control in aquaculture.
items.title_zh: Trpv4在雌雄同体稻田鳝的温度与睾丸分化中的联系
items.summary_zh: 稻田鳝（Monopterus albus）是中国重要的水产养殖物种，具有原雌性雌雄同体特征。尽管对其性别决定与分化已有一定了解，但机制仍不明确。本研究表明，温暖的环境温度通过上调睾丸分化基因（如dmrt1和sox9a）促进性腺转化。Trpv4是一种在性腺体细胞中表达的Ca²⁺通透阳离子通道，对环境温度高度敏感，连接环境温度与稻田鳝的睾丸分化。在低温下饲养的雌鱼中，向卵巢注射Trpv4激动剂显著上调雄性通路基因，而在高温下的雌鱼中，抑制Trpv4或trpv4 siRNA敲低则抑制温度诱导的雄性基因表达。pStat3信号通路位于Trpv4下游，将Trpv4控制的钙信号转导至性别决定级联反应。抑制pStat3活性可阻止温度处理和Trpv4激动剂注射引起的睾丸分化基因上调，而激活pStat3则足以在Trpv4拮抗剂存在下诱导雄性基因表达。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示Trpv4通道通过调控pStat3信号通路，连接环境温度与雌雄同体稻田鳝的睾丸分化，温暖环境促进雄性基因表达。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了Trpv4（瞬时受体电位通道4）在雌雄同体稻田鳝（Monopterus albus）温度与睾丸分化中的作用。稻田鳝是中国重要的水产养殖物种，具有原雌性雌雄同体特征，尽管对其性别决定与分化已有一定了解，但具体机制仍不明确。研究发现，温暖的环境温度能够通过上调睾丸分化基因（如dmrt1和sox9a）来促进性腺转化。Trpv4作为一种在性腺体细胞中表达的Ca²⁺通透阳离子通道，对环境温度高度敏感，成为连接环境温度与稻田鳝睾丸分化的重要因素。

在实验中，研究者对低温下饲养的雌鱼进行了处理，向其卵巢注射Trpv4激动剂，结果显示雄性通路基因显著上调。而在高温环境下，抑制Trpv4或使用trpv4 siRNA敲低则抑制了温度诱导的雄性基因表达。这表明Trpv4在温度调控下对性别分化具有重要影响。此外，研究还发现pStat3信号通路位于Trpv4下游，负责将Trpv4控制的钙信号转导至性别决定的级联反应中。抑制pStat3活性能够阻止温度处理和Trpv4激动剂注射引起的睾丸分化基因上调，而激活pStat3则足以在Trpv4拮抗剂存在的情况下诱导雄性基因表达。

综上所述，本研究揭示了Trpv4在稻田鳝性别分化中的关键作用，强调了环境温度通过Trpv4及其下游信号通路pStat3对睾丸分化基因的调控。这一发现为理解稻田鳝的性别决定机制提供了新的视角，并可能对水产养殖中的性别控制策略产生重要影响。

items.title: Stage-specific threats reveal the inadequacy of adult-centered conservation
items.abstract: In an era of severe global biodiversity threats, understanding the link between species’ traits and their endangerment helps uncover causes of risk and infer threats to understudied species. Most animals have complex life cycles with distinct stages that may face stage-specific threats. Current conservation frameworks rely heavily on adult traits, potentially misjudging extinction risk. Using Chinese anurans as a model, we integrated functional traits from both adult and tadpole stages to examine their association with extinction risk. We found that body size positively correlates with risk in both stages. Microhabitat use is related to extinction risk in tadpoles, but shows no significant link in adults. Adult relative tympanum diameter and head length also correlate with extinction risk. These results indicate that species vulnerability is correlated with multi-stage traits, with both shared and stage-specific threats. Conservation based solely on adult traits may fail to accurately assess species threats. We call for integrating a whole-life-history perspective into biodiversity assessment and conservation to more effectively address the global biodiversity crisis.
items.title_zh: 阶段特异性威胁揭示以成年为中心的保护不足
items.summary_zh: 在全球生物多样性面临严重威胁的时代，理解物种特征与其濒危之间的联系有助于揭示风险原因并推断未被充分研究物种的威胁。大多数动物具有复杂的生命周期，各阶段可能面临特定威胁。本研究以中国的蛙类为模型，整合了成年和蝌蚪阶段的功能性状，以考察其与灭绝风险的关联。结果发现，体型在两个阶段与风险呈正相关。微栖息地使用与蝌蚪的灭绝风险相关，但在成年个体中未显示显著关联。成年个体的相对鼓膜直径和头长也与灭绝风险相关。这些结果表明，物种脆弱性与多阶段特征相关，存在共享和阶段特异性威胁。仅基于成年特征的保护措施可能无法准确评估物种威胁。我们呼吁在生物多样性评估和保护中整合全生命周期视角，以更有效地应对全球生物多样性危机。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了物种在不同生命周期阶段面临的特定威胁，强调仅依赖成年特征的保护措施可能不足以有效评估和应对灭绝风险。
items.l2_summary: 在全球生物多样性面临严重威胁的背景下，理解物种特征与其濒危之间的关系显得尤为重要。本研究以中国的蛙类为模型，探讨了其不同生命周期阶段（成年和蝌蚪）与灭绝风险之间的关联。研究整合了这两个阶段的功能性状，结果显示，体型在成年和蝌蚪阶段均与灭绝风险呈正相关。此外，微栖息地使用与蝌蚪的灭绝风险相关，但在成年个体中并未显示出显著的关联性。成年个体的相对鼓膜直径和头长也与灭绝风险存在相关性。这些发现表明，物种的脆弱性与其多阶段特征密切相关，存在共享和阶段特异性威胁。因此，仅基于成年特征的保护措施可能无法准确评估物种的威胁程度。研究呼吁在生物多样性评估和保护中整合全生命周期视角，以更有效地应对全球生物多样性危机。通过全面考虑不同生命周期阶段的特征，能够更好地识别和应对物种面临的多重威胁，从而制定出更为有效的保护策略。

items.title: REM sleep prefrontal high-frequency oscillation chains mediate distinct cortical – hippocampal reactivation patterns compared to NREM sleep
items.abstract: REM (rapid eye movement) and non-REM (NREM) sleep stages contribute to systems memory consolidation in hippocampal–cortical circuits. However, the physiological mechanisms underlying REM memory processes remain relatively unclear compared to NREM memory reactivation. Here we report, in rodents, the existence of prefrontal cortical (PFC) high-frequency oscillation (HFO) chains in REM sleep during the consolidation of recently acquired spatial memory. High-density tetrode recordings in hippocampal area CA1 and PFC reveal that REM cortical HFOs occur in characteristic chains that are phase-modulated by theta oscillations, corresponding to increased CA1-PFC theta coherence and delineating periods of enhanced hippocampal–cortical communication. REM HFO chains sequentially organize sparse PFC ensemble reactivation of behavioral activity during periods of local suppression, distinct from widespread reactivation bursts during NREM ripple oscillations. REM HFO chains also preferentially engage CA1 neuronal populations that demonstrate a shift in their preferred theta-phase from behavior to REM sleep. CA1 neuronal activation during REM HFO chains was correlated with CA1 activity suppression during NREM PFC ripples, and linked to differential changes in CA1 firing rates in sleep, suggesting REM-driven regulation of hippocampal excitability. A cortical network model incorporating the effects of acetylcholine can reproduce the distinct REM and NREM activity patterns, providing a mechanistic basis for widespread coactivity during NREM cortical ripples, compared to sparse, temporally extended reactivation on a background of local suppression during REM HFO chains. Overall, these findings establish a role for PFC HFOs in regulating distinct dual sleep stage reactivation patterns.
items.title_zh: REM睡眠前额叶高频振荡链介导独特的皮层-海马重激活模式
items.summary_zh: REM（快速眼动）睡眠和非REM（NREM）睡眠阶段在海马-皮层回路中的系统记忆巩固中发挥作用。然而，与NREM记忆重激活相比，REM记忆过程的生理机制仍不够明确。本研究在啮齿动物中发现，REM睡眠期间存在前额叶皮层（PFC）高频振荡（HFO）链，伴随最近获得的空间记忆的巩固。高密度四电极记录显示，REM皮层HFO以特征性链条出现，受θ振荡相位调制，表明CA1-PFC的θ相干性增加，划定了海马-皮层通信增强的时期。REM HFO链依次组织PFC稀疏集体重激活行为活动，与NREM波动期间的广泛重激活突发不同。REM HFO链还优先激活CA1神经元群体，这些神经元在行为和REM睡眠之间的θ相位偏好发生了变化。REM HFO链期间CA1神经元的激活与NREM PFC波动期间CA1活动抑制相关，并与睡眠中CA1放电率的差异变化相关，提示REM驱动的海马兴奋性调节。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，REM睡眠期间前额叶高频振荡链介导了独特的海马-皮层重激活模式，增强了空间记忆的巩固。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了快速眼动（REM）睡眠在海马-皮层回路中的记忆巩固机制，特别是与非REM（NREM）睡眠相比，REM睡眠期间的生理过程。研究发现，在REM睡眠阶段，前额叶皮层（PFC）出现高频振荡（HFO）链，这一现象与最近获得的空间记忆的巩固密切相关。通过高密度四电极记录，研究者观察到REM睡眠中的皮层HFO以特征性链条的形式出现，并且受到θ振荡相位的调制，这表明海马CA1区与前额叶皮层之间的θ相干性增强，从而划定了海马-皮层通信增强的时间段。

进一步分析显示，REM HFO链能够依次组织PFC的稀疏集体重激活行为活动，这与NREM睡眠期间的广泛重激活突发现象显著不同。此外，REM HFO链优先激活CA1神经元群体，这些神经元在行为和REM睡眠之间的θ相位偏好发生了变化。值得注意的是，REM HFO链期间CA1神经元的激活与NREM PFC波动期间CA1活动的抑制相关，并且与睡眠中CA1放电率的差异变化存在关联。这些结果提示REM驱动的海马兴奋性调节在记忆巩固过程中发挥了重要作用。

综上所述，本研究揭示了REM睡眠期间前额叶高频振荡链在记忆重激活中的独特作用，强调了REM睡眠在海马-皮层回路中对记忆巩固的关键影响。这一发现为理解睡眠不同阶段在记忆处理中的生理机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Realistic coupling enables flexible macroscopic traveling waves in the mouse cortex
items.abstract: Traveling waves are ubiquitous in neuronal systems across different spatial scales. While microscopic and mesoscopic waves are relatively well studied, the emergence of macroscopic traveling waves remains less understood. Here, by modeling the mouse cortex using spatial transcriptomic and connectivity data, we show that realistic cortical connectivity can generate a significantly higher level of macroscopic traveling waves than artificial local and uniform connectivity across multiple oscillation frequency bands, with the strongest advantage appearing in the theta, alpha, and beta frequency bands. By probing the model in different dynamic regimes, we find that macroscopic wave activity depends on both network connectivity and excitatory coupling strength, with a non-monotonic dependence on coupling. Together, our work shows how flexible macroscopic traveling waves can emerge in the mouse cortex and offers a computational framework to further study traveling waves in the mouse brain at the single-cell level.
items.title_zh: 真实耦合促进小鼠皮层灵活的宏观行波
items.summary_zh: 行波在不同空间尺度的神经系统中普遍存在。尽管微观和中观波动已得到相对较好的研究，宏观行波的出现仍不够清楚。本文通过利用空间转录组学和连接性数据对小鼠皮层进行建模，发现真实的皮层连接性能够在多个振荡频率带中产生显著高于人工局部和均匀连接的宏观行波，尤其在θ、α和β频率带中表现出最强的优势。通过在不同动态状态下探测模型，我们发现宏观波动活动依赖于网络连接性和兴奋性耦合强度，并且对耦合的依赖呈非单调性。我们的研究展示了小鼠皮层中灵活的宏观行波如何产生，并提供了一个计算框架，以进一步在单细胞水平研究小鼠大脑中的行波。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现小鼠皮层中的真实连接性能够显著增强宏观行波的出现，尤其在θ、α和β频率带中表现突出，为进一步研究大脑行波提供了新的计算框架。
items.l2_summary:
行波在神经系统的不同空间尺度中普遍存在，然而宏观行波的形成机制仍不够明确。本文通过空间转录组学和连接性数据对小鼠皮层进行建模，探讨了真实的皮层连接性对宏观行波的影响。研究发现，真实的皮层连接性在多个振荡频率带中产生的宏观行波显著高于人工构建的局部和均匀连接，尤其在θ（4-8 Hz）、α（8-12 Hz）和β（12-30 Hz）频率带中表现出最强的优势。这一发现表明，真实的神经连接模式对宏观行波的生成具有重要作用。

在不同动态状态下的模型探测中，研究表明宏观波动活动依赖于网络连接性和兴奋性耦合强度，并且这种依赖关系呈现非单调性。这意味着在某些条件下，增加耦合强度可能会导致宏观波动活动的减少，而在其他条件下则可能增强波动活动。这一复杂的耦合关系为理解小鼠皮层中宏观行波的灵活性提供了新的视角。

总的来说，本文展示了小鼠皮层中灵活的宏观行波是如何产生的，并提出了一个计算框架，以便在单细胞水平上进一步研究小鼠大脑中的行波。这些结果不仅丰富了我们对神经网络动态行为的理解，也为未来的研究提供了重要的理论基础和实验方向。

items.title: Soil extracellular DNA fragments show variable degradation rates among sequences and environmental conditions
items.abstract: While extracellular DNA (eDNA) persistence substantially influences soil microbiome investigations, its degradation kinetics remain poorly quantified. Here, we developed a primer-labeled DNA approach coupled with microcosm incubation to determine the overall and sequence-specific degradation rates of eDNA amplicon fragments across China. We observed substantial variations in the overall degradation rates of extracellular 16S rRNA gene amplicon fragments among the study sites, with degradation rate constants ranging from 0.05 to 0.16 day −1 . The overall degradation rate constants showed significant correlations with soil moisture content, prokaryotic abundance, prokaryotic community profiles, and mean annual precipitation. The significant influences of moisture content on the overall degradation rates were further verified by a moisture gradient microcosm experiment. The sequence-specific degradation rate constant profiles were additionally correlated with pH, nitrogen content, and mean annual temperature. Furthermore, propidium monoazide-based exclusion of eDNA signals significantly altered soil prokaryotic abundance, richness, and prokaryotic community profiles, and the pool sizes of sequence-specific extracellular 16S rRNA gene amplicon fragments were significantly correlated with their respective degradation rates. This study developed a methodology for determining the overall and sequence-specific degradation rates of eDNA amplicon fragments, highlighting the profound influences of eDNA on soil microbial research and informing the optimization of environmental DNA technologies.
items.title_zh: 土壤细胞外DNA片段在不同序列和环境条件下的降解速率差异
items.summary_zh: 细胞外DNA（eDNA）的持久性对土壤微生物组研究有重要影响，但其降解动力学尚未得到充分量化。本研究采用引物标记的DNA方法结合微宇宙培养，测定了中国不同地点eDNA扩增子片段的整体及序列特异性降解速率。结果显示，外源16S rRNA基因扩增子片段的整体降解速率在研究地点间存在显著差异，降解速率常数范围为0.05至0.16天⁻¹。整体降解速率常数与土壤水分含量、原核生物丰度、原核生物群落特征及年均降水量显著相关。水分含量对整体降解速率的影响通过水分梯度微宇宙实验得到了进一步验证。此外，序列特异性降解速率常数与pH、氮含量及年均温度也存在相关性。本研究为eDNA降解速率的测定提供了一种新方法。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，土壤细胞外DNA的降解速率受水分含量、原核生物丰度及环境因素显著影响，且不同地点间存在明显差异。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了土壤中细胞外DNA（eDNA）片段在不同序列和环境条件下的降解速率差异，强调了eDNA的持久性对土壤微生物组研究的重要性。研究采用引物标记的DNA方法结合微宇宙培养，测定了中国多个地点的eDNA扩增子片段的整体及序列特异性降解速率。结果表明，外源16S rRNA基因扩增子片段的整体降解速率在不同研究地点间存在显著差异，降解速率常数范围为0.05至0.16天⁻¹。这一发现揭示了土壤环境对eDNA降解的影响，整体降解速率常数与土壤水分含量、原核生物丰度、原核生物群落特征及年均降水量显著相关。通过水分梯度微宇宙实验，进一步验证了水分含量对整体降解速率的影响。此外，序列特异性降解速率常数与土壤pH、氮含量及年均温度也存在相关性。这些结果为eDNA降解速率的测定提供了一种新方法，丰富了我们对土壤微生物生态系统中eDNA动态的理解。研究结果不仅为未来的土壤微生物组研究提供了重要的理论基础，也为相关领域的应用研究提供了新的视角。

items.title: Ribosomal RNA methylation by GidB modulates discrimination of mischarged tRNA
items.abstract: Despite redundant cellular pathways to minimize translational errors, errors in protein synthesis are common. Pathways and mechanisms to minimize errors are classified as pre-ribosomal or ribosomal. Pre-ribosomal pathways are primarily concerned with the appropriate charging of tRNAs with their cognate amino acids. By contrast, the ribosomal decoding center is considered ‘blind’ to mischarged tRNAs since these have cognate codon•anti-codon pairing. Here, we identified that in mycobacteria, deletion of the 16S ribosomal RNA methyltransferase gidB led to increased ribosomal discrimination of mischarged tRNAs. Discrimination only occurred in mycobacteria enriched from environments or genetic backgrounds with high rates of mistranslation. GidB deletion was necessary, but not sufficient for reducing mistranslation due to misacylation. Analysis of new cryo-EM structures of the M. smegmatis ribosomes derived from wild-type and gidB -deleted strains point to the interaction between the base methylated by GidB on the 16S RNA and an asparagine on the ribosomal S12 protein that, when mistranslated to aspartate, may be involved in altering translational fidelity. Our data suggest a mechanism by which mycobacterial ribosomes can discriminate mischarged tRNAs and that 16S rRNA differential methylation by GidB may act to prevent catastrophic translational error.
items.title_zh: GidB介导的核糖体RNA甲基化调节错误充电tRNA的识别
items.summary_zh: 尽管细胞内存在多条冗余途径以减少翻译错误，但蛋白质合成中的错误仍然普遍。研究发现，在分枝杆菌中，删除16S核糖体RNA甲基转移酶gidB会导致对错误充电tRNA的核糖体识别能力增强。这种识别仅发生在来自高误翻译环境或遗传背景的分枝杆菌中。gidB的缺失是减少因错误酰化导致的误翻译所必需的，但并不足以单独实现。通过分析来自野生型和gidB缺失株的M. smegmatis核糖体的新型冷冻电镜结构，发现GidB在16S RNA上甲基化的碱基与核糖体S12蛋白上的天冬酰胺相互作用，当其误翻译为天冬氨酸时，可能影响翻译的准确性。我们的数据表明，分枝杆菌核糖体能够识别错误充电tRNA，且GidB介导的16S rRNA差异甲基化可能有助于防止严重的翻译错误。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，GidB介导的16S核糖体RNA甲基化在分枝杆菌中增强了对错误充电tRNA的识别能力，从而有助于减少翻译错误。
items.l2_summary:
在细胞内，尽管存在多条冗余途径以减少翻译错误，但蛋白质合成中的错误仍然普遍存在。研究表明，在分枝杆菌中，缺失16S核糖体RNA甲基转移酶GidB（gidB）会增强核糖体对错误充电tRNA的识别能力。这种现象主要发生在来自高误翻译环境或特定遗传背景的分枝杆菌中。虽然gidB的缺失是减少因错误酰化导致的误翻译所必需的，但仅靠这一因素并不足以完全解决问题。

通过对野生型和gidB缺失株的M. smegmatis核糖体进行新型冷冻电镜结构分析，研究发现GidB在16S RNA上的甲基化碱基与核糖体S12蛋白上的天冬酰胺发生相互作用。当天冬酰胺被误翻译为天冬氨酸时，这种相互作用可能会影响翻译的准确性。研究结果表明，分枝杆菌的核糖体能够有效识别错误充电tRNA，而GidB介导的16S rRNA差异甲基化可能在防止严重翻译错误方面发挥重要作用。这一发现为理解细胞如何应对翻译错误提供了新的视角，并强调了GidB在维持翻译准确性中的关键角色。

items.title: Low-frequency tibial neuromodulation excites bladder activity in humans
items.abstract: Despite widespread clinical adoption for disorders of incontinence such as overactive bladder, there remain unknowns surrounding the mechanism that underpins tibial nerve stimulation (TNS). Current understanding suggests that TNS counteracts incontinence by the inhibition of brainstem and spinal cord activity. How this inhibition alters bladder function is not fully understood. We hypothesize that the supraspinal components of the system act as a high-pass filter, allowing voiding signals to proceed only when bladder filling reaches a critical level. Testing this hypothesis may explain how TNS is able to induce both an inhibitory and a little-explored excitatory effect on bladder activity in response to high-frequency (20 Hz) and low-frequency (1 Hz) stimulation, respectively. We performed a single-blinded trial in healthy human participants administered high- and low-frequency transcutaneous TNS. We also developed a computational model of the lower-urinary tract and control circuit to study the frequency-dependent effects of TNS. For the first time, we report a frequency-dependent effect of TNS via the ability to alter urge perception and upregulate and downregulate bladder activity, corroborating model predictions. These results provide a foundation for the development of targeted and effective TNS therapies, benefiting from in silico models. We hope that future clinical research will determine the efficacy of low-frequency TNS as a non-invasive treatment option for urinary retention.
items.title_zh: 低频胫神经调节在人类膀胱活动中的激发作用
items.summary_zh: 尽管胫神经刺激（TNS）已广泛应用于治疗如膀胱过度活动等失禁症状，但其机制仍不明确。当前理解认为，TNS通过抑制脑干和脊髓活动来对抗失禁，但这种抑制如何影响膀胱功能尚不清楚。我们假设该系统的超脊髓成分充当高通滤波器，仅在膀胱充盈达到临界水平时允许排尿信号传递。我们在健康人群中进行了一项单盲试验，比较高频（20 Hz）和低频（1 Hz）经皮TNS的效果，并开发了下尿路及控制电路的计算模型，研究TNS的频率依赖效应。首次报告了TNS的频率依赖效应，能够改变排尿感知并调节膀胱活动，验证了模型预测。这些结果为开发针对性和有效的TNS疗法奠定了基础。
items.l1_lead: 低频胫神经刺激能够有效调节膀胱活动并改变排尿感知，为针对性治疗膀胱失禁提供了新的理论依据。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了低频胫神经刺激（TNS）在调节人类膀胱活动中的作用，尽管TNS已被广泛应用于治疗膀胱过度活动等失禁症状，但其具体机制尚不明确。现有的理解认为，TNS通过抑制脑干和脊髓的活动来对抗失禁，但这种抑制如何影响膀胱功能仍然不清楚。研究者假设该系统的超脊髓成分充当高通滤波器，仅在膀胱充盈达到临界水平时才允许排尿信号的传递。

为验证这一假设，研究团队在健康人群中进行了单盲试验，比较了高频（20 Hz）和低频（1 Hz）经皮TNS的效果，并开发了下尿路及控制电路的计算模型，以研究TNS的频率依赖效应。研究首次报告了TNS的频率依赖效应，结果显示不同频率的TNS能够显著改变排尿感知并调节膀胱活动，验证了模型的预测。这些发现为开发更加针对性和有效的TNS疗法奠定了基础，提示在临床应用中可能需要根据患者的具体情况选择合适的刺激频率，以优化治疗效果。通过这一研究，科学界对TNS在膀胱功能调节中的作用有了更深入的理解，为未来相关治疗的研究提供了新的方向。

items.title: The insulin/IGF axis is critically important for controlling gene transcription in the podocyte
items.abstract: Podocyte integrity depends critically on signalling through the insulin receptor and IGF1 receptor , and this study defines their combined importance using dual-receptor knockdown in mice and cultured podocytes. Podocyte-specific reduction of both receptors in transgenic mice caused kidney disease characterised by albuminuria and glomerulosclerosis, with premature death occurring in some animals between 4 and 24 weeks. Receptor-deficient cultured podocytes exhibited 50% cell loss within 7 days. Integrated proteomic and transcriptomic analyses revealed marked depletion of spliceosome-associated proteins and widespread intron retention with premature termination codons, indicating profound disruption of RNA processing. Phospho-proteomic profiling further showed that insulin/IGF1 stimulation induces dynamic post-translational modifications across spliceosomal components and regulatory kinases. Together, these findings uncover a previously unrecognised role for podocyte insulin/IGF1 signalling in maintaining spliceosomal integrity and transcriptional fidelity, establishing this hormonal axis as a key extrinsic regulator of podocyte gene expression.
items.title_zh: 胰岛素/IGF轴在足细胞基因转录中的重要性
items.summary_zh: 足细胞的完整性依赖于胰岛素受体和IGF1受体的信号传导。本研究通过在小鼠和培养的足细胞中进行双受体敲除，定义了它们的联合重要性。在转基因小鼠中，特异性减少这两种受体导致肾病，表现为蛋白尿和肾小球硬化，部分动物在4至24周内出现早亡。缺乏受体的培养足细胞在7天内出现50%的细胞损失。综合的蛋白质组学和转录组学分析显示，剪接体相关蛋白显著减少，并伴有广泛的内含子保留和早期终止密码子，表明RNA加工严重受损。磷酸化蛋白质组分析进一步显示，胰岛素/IGF1刺激引发剪接体组分和调控激酶的动态后转译修饰。这些发现揭示了足细胞胰岛素/IGF1信号在维持剪接体完整性和转录准确性方面的未被认识的作用，确立了这一激素轴作为足细胞基因表达的关键外源调节因子。
items.l1_lead: 胰岛素/IGF轴在足细胞基因转录中发挥关键作用，其信号传导缺失会导致细胞损失和肾病，揭示了其在维持剪接体完整性和转录准确性的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了胰岛素/IGF轴（胰岛素样生长因子轴）在足细胞基因转录中的重要性，强调了胰岛素受体和IGF1受体在维持足细胞完整性方面的关键作用。通过在小鼠和培养的足细胞中进行双受体敲除实验，研究团队揭示了这两种受体的联合缺失对肾脏健康的严重影响。转基因小鼠中，特异性减少胰岛素受体和IGF1受体导致了肾病的发生，表现为蛋白尿和肾小球硬化，部分小鼠在4至24周内出现早亡现象。此外，缺乏这两种受体的培养足细胞在7天内出现了50%的细胞损失，进一步证明了受体在细胞存活中的重要性。

为深入理解这一机制，研究者进行了综合的蛋白质组学和转录组学分析，结果显示剪接体相关蛋白显著减少，并伴随广泛的内含子保留和早期终止密码子，这表明RNA加工过程受到严重损害。此外，磷酸化蛋白质组分析显示，胰岛素/IGF1刺激能够引发剪接体组分和调控激酶的动态后转译修饰。这些发现揭示了胰岛素/IGF1信号在维持剪接体完整性和转录准确性方面的重要作用，确立了这一激素轴作为足细胞基因表达的关键外源调节因子。综上所述，胰岛素/IGF轴在足细胞的功能和生存中扮演着不可或缺的角色，其信号传导的缺失可能导致严重的肾脏疾病。

items.title: Squidly harnesses enzyme functional hierarchy and contrastive learning to efficiently predict catalytic residues from sequence
items.abstract: Enzymes present a sustainable alternative to traditional chemical industries, drug synthesis, and bioremediation applications. Because catalytic residues are the key amino acids that drive enzyme function, their accurate prediction facilitates enzyme function prediction. Sequence similarity-based approaches such as BLAST are fast but require previously annotated homologues. Machine-learning (ML) approaches aim to overcome this limitation; however, current gold-standard ML-based methods require high-quality 3D structures limiting their application to large datasets. To address these challenges, we developed Squidly, a sequence-only tool that leverages contrastive representation learning with a biology-informed, rationally designed pairing scheme to distinguish catalytic from non-catalytic residues using per-token Protein Language Model embeddings. Squidly surpasses state-of-the-art ML annotation methods in catalytic residue prediction while remaining sufficiently fast to enable wide-scale screening of databases. We ensemble Squidly with BLAST to provide an efficient tool that annotates catalytic residues with high precision and recall for both in- and out-of-distribution sequences.
items.title_zh: Squidly利用酶功能层次和对比学习高效预测催化残基
items.summary_zh: 酶是传统化学工业、药物合成和生物修复应用的可持续替代品。催化残基是驱动酶功能的关键氨基酸，其准确预测有助于酶功能预测。基于序列相似性的BLAST方法快速但需依赖已注释的同源物。机器学习（ML）方法旨在克服这一限制，但当前的金标准ML方法需要高质量的3D结构，限制了其在大数据集中的应用。为解决这些挑战，我们开发了Squidly，这是一种仅基于序列的工具，利用对比表示学习和生物信息驱动的配对方案，通过每个标记的蛋白质语言模型嵌入区分催化与非催化残基。Squidly在催化残基预测上超越了最先进的ML注释方法，同时保持足够的速度以支持大规模数据库筛选。我们将Squidly与BLAST结合，提供了一种高精度和高召回率的催化残基注释工具，适用于分布内外的序列。
items.l1_lead: Squidly是一种基于序列的工具，通过对比学习和生物信息驱动的配对方案，能够高效准确地预测催化残基，超越传统机器学习方法。
items.l2_summary:
酶作为传统化学工业、药物合成和生物修复的可持续替代品，其催化残基是驱动酶功能的关键氨基酸，准确预测这些催化残基对于酶功能的理解和应用至关重要。传统的基于序列相似性的BLAST方法虽然快速，但依赖于已注释的同源物，限制了其在未注释序列中的应用。为了解决这一问题，研究者们开发了Squidly，这是一种仅基于序列的工具，利用对比表示学习（contrastive representation learning）和生物信息驱动的配对方案，通过每个标记的蛋白质语言模型（protein language model）嵌入来区分催化与非催化残基。Squidly在催化残基预测方面的表现超越了现有的最先进机器学习（ML）注释方法，同时保持了足够的速度，能够支持大规模数据库的筛选。

具体而言，Squidly结合了BLAST的优势，提供了一种高精度和高召回率的催化残基注释工具，适用于分布内外的序列。这种方法不仅提高了催化残基的预测准确性，还克服了传统方法在高质量三维结构需求上的限制，使得在大数据集中的应用成为可能。通过这种创新的工具，研究者能够更有效地进行酶功能的预测和分析，为相关领域的研究和应用提供了重要的技术支持。总之，Squidly的开发为催化残基的预测提供了一种新的思路和方法，推动了酶研究的进展。

items.title: Polo-like kinase phosphorylation of the orphan kinesin KIN-G negatively regulates centrin arm biogenesis in Trypanosoma brucei
items.abstract: The unicellular parasite Trypanosoma brucei assembles a motile flagellum that is required for locomotion, cell division plane placement, and cell-cell communication. Inheritance of the flagellum during the cell cycle relies on the faithful duplication/segregation of multiple flagellum-associated cytoskeletal structures, including a centrin-marked, bar-shaped structure termed centrin arm, which also determines the site for Golgi assembly. Biogenesis of the centrin arm requires the Polo-like kinase homolog TbPLK and the orphan kinesin KIN-G, but the mechanistic role of TbPLK in centrin arm biogenesis remains elusive. Here, we report that TbPLK phosphorylates KIN-G, disrupts its microtubule-binding activity, and negatively regulates its function. TbPLK phosphorylates KIN-G in vitro at multiple residues, two of which are in vivo TbPLK phosphosites, including the Thr301 residue within one of the microtubule-binding motifs of the kinesin motor domain. Phosphorylation of Thr301 by TbPLK inhibits the microtubule-binding activity of KIN-G in vitro, and expression of a Thr301 phospho-mimic mutant in T. brucei disrupts centrin arm integrity, Golgi duplication, flagellum attachment zone elongation, flagellum positioning, and cell division plane placement. In wild-type T. brucei cells, Thr301 phosphorylation occurs on a small portion of the KIN-G population, suggesting that KIN-G undergoes phosphorylation/dephosphorylation cycles to regulate its activity. Together, these findings uncover a negative role of TbPLK-mediated phosphorylation of KIN-G in regulating centrin arm biogenesis in trypanosomes.
items.title_zh: Polo样激酶磷酸化孤儿动力蛋白KIN-G负调节锥体臂生物发生
items.summary_zh: 单细胞寄生虫锥虫（Trypanosoma brucei）组装的运动鞭毛对于运动、细胞分裂平面定位和细胞间通信至关重要。鞭毛在细胞周期中的遗传依赖于多个与鞭毛相关的细胞骨架结构的准确复制和分配，其中包括一种标记有锥体的棒状结构——锥体臂，后者还决定高尔基体组装的位置。锥体臂的生物发生需要Polo样激酶同源物TbPLK和孤儿动力蛋白KIN-G，但TbPLK在锥体臂生物发生中的机制作用尚不清楚。我们发现TbPLK磷酸化KIN-G，破坏其微管结合活性，并负调节其功能。TbPLK在体外磷酸化KIN-G的多个残基，其中两个是体内TbPLK磷酸化位点，包括动力蛋白马达域微管结合基序中的Thr301残基。TbPLK对Thr301的磷酸化在体外抑制KIN-G的微管结合活性，而在锥虫中表达Thr301磷酸模仿突变体则破坏锥体臂的完整性、高尔基体复制、鞭毛附着区延长、鞭毛定位和细胞分裂平面定位。在野生型锥虫细胞中，Thr301的磷酸化发生在KIN-G群体的一小部分上，表明KIN-G经历了调控。
items.l1_lead: Polo样激酶通过磷酸化孤儿动力蛋白KIN-G，负调节锥虫锥体臂的生物发生，影响鞭毛的定位和细胞分裂。
items.l2_summary:
在单细胞寄生虫锥虫（Trypanosoma brucei）中，运动鞭毛的组装对于细胞的运动、分裂平面定位以及细胞间通信至关重要。鞭毛的形成依赖于多个与鞭毛相关的细胞骨架结构的准确复制和分配，其中锥体臂作为一种标记有锥体的棒状结构，起着关键作用，并决定高尔基体的组装位置。锥体臂的生物发生需要Polo样激酶同源物TbPLK和孤儿动力蛋白KIN-G的共同作用，但TbPLK在这一过程中的具体机制尚不明确。

研究发现，TbPLK能够磷酸化KIN-G，进而破坏其与微管的结合活性，从而负调节KIN-G的功能。TbPLK在体外磷酸化KIN-G的多个残基，其中包括两个在体内被磷酸化的位点，尤其是动力蛋白马达域微管结合基序中的Thr301残基。对Thr301的磷酸化在体外显著抑制了KIN-G的微管结合活性，而在锥虫中表达Thr301磷酸模仿突变体则导致锥体臂的完整性受损、高尔基体复制异常、鞭毛附着区延长以及鞭毛和细胞分裂平面定位的失调。

在野生型锥虫细胞中，Thr301的磷酸化仅发生在KIN-G群体的一小部分，表明KIN-G的功能受到调控。这些结果表明，TbPLK通过磷酸化KIN-G来调节锥体臂的生物发生，从而影响锥虫的细胞运动和分裂过程。这项研究为理解锥虫细胞骨架的动态调控机制提供了新的视角，并揭示了TbPLK在细胞周期中的重要作用。

items.title: Differential locus coeruleus–hippocampus interactions during offline states
items.abstract: Patterns of locus coeruleus (LC) activity and norepinephrine (NE) release during non-rapid-eye-movement sleep suggest a critical role for the LC–NE system in offline modulation of forebrain circuits. NE transmission promotes synaptic plasticity and is required for memory consolidation, but the field has only begun to uncover how LC activity contributes to coordinated forebrain network dynamics. Hippocampal ripples, a hallmark of memory replay, are temporally coupled with thalamocortical oscillations; however, the circuit mechanisms underlying system-level consolidation across larger brain networks remain incompletely understood. Here, using multi-site electrophysiology, we examined LC firing in relation to hippocampal ripples in freely behaving rats. LC activity and ripple occurrence were state-dependent and inversely related: heightened arousal was associated with increased LC firing and reduced ripple rates. At finer timescales, LC spiking decreased ∼1–2 s before ripple onset, with the strongest modulation during awake ripples but minimal change during ripple–spindle coupling. These findings reveal state-dependent dynamics of LC–hippocampal interactions, positioning the LC as a key component of a cortical–subcortical network supporting system-level memory consolidation.
items.title_zh: 蓝斑-海马在离线状态下的差异性相互作用
items.summary_zh: 研究表明，蓝斑（LC）活动和去甲肾上腺素（NE）释放在非快速眼动睡眠期间的模式，暗示LC-NE系统在前脑电路的离线调节中发挥关键作用。NE传递促进突触可塑性并对记忆巩固至关重要，但关于LC活动如何影响前脑网络动态的研究仍在初步阶段。我们使用多点电生理技术，研究了自由活动大鼠中LC放电与海马波动的关系。结果显示，LC活动和海马波动的发生具有状态依赖性且呈反比：高度唤醒与LC放电增加和海马波动率降低相关。在更细的时间尺度上，LC放电在海马波动开始前约1-2秒减少，清醒状态下的海马波动调制最强，而在波动-纺锤体耦合期间变化最小。这些发现揭示了LC-海马相互作用的状态依赖动态，确立了LC作为支持系统级记忆巩固的皮层-下皮层网络的关键组成部分。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，蓝斑-去甲肾上腺素系统在非快速眼动睡眠期间通过状态依赖性动态调节海马波动，对记忆巩固起关键作用。
items.l2_summary:
研究表明，蓝斑（locus coeruleus, LC）活动与去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine, NE）释放在非快速眼动睡眠期间的模式，暗示LC-NE系统在前脑电路的离线调节中发挥着关键作用。去甲肾上腺素的传递促进突触可塑性，并对记忆的巩固至关重要，但关于LC活动如何影响前脑网络动态的研究仍处于初步阶段。为此，研究团队采用多点电生理技术，探讨了自由活动大鼠中LC放电与海马（hippocampus）波动之间的关系。

研究结果显示，LC活动与海马波动的发生具有状态依赖性且呈反比关系：在高度唤醒状态下，LC放电增加，而海马波动率则降低。此外，在更细的时间尺度上，LC放电在海马波动开始前约1-2秒减少，这表明LC的活动与海马的波动存在时间上的前后关系。研究还发现，清醒状态下的海马波动调制最为强烈，而在波动-纺锤体（spindle）耦合期间，LC活动的变化最小。这些发现揭示了LC与海马之间的相互作用具有状态依赖的动态特征，进一步确立了LC作为支持系统级记忆巩固的皮层-下皮层网络的关键组成部分。

综上所述，该研究为理解LC-NE系统在前脑电路中的作用提供了重要的实验依据，强调了LC在记忆巩固过程中的重要性，并为未来研究提供了新的方向。

items.title: In extracto cryo-EM reveals eEF2 as a major hibernation factor on 60S and 80S particles
items.abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) made impressive progress in resolving cellular macromolecules and their detailed interactions. Single-particle cryo-EM traditionally relies on purified macromolecules and lacks the complexity of cellular environments, whereas in situ cryo-EM and cryogenic electron tomography (cryo-ET) require extensive sample preparation and data acquisition, presenting challenges in achieving high resolution. We describe cryo-EM of cellular lysates— in extracto cryo-EM—allowing the flexibility and high-resolution of cryo-EM in the context of cellular components. High-resolution 2D template matching (2DTM) yields ~2.2 Å maps of the mammalian translational apparatus. Elongating ribosome abundances in primate cell lines (MCF-7 and BSC-1) and rabbit reticulocyte lysates range from ~70% to ~10%, reflecting translational stress responses. Non-translating (hibernating) ribosomes carrying no mRNA feature numerous proteins shielding ribosomal functional centers. Elongation factor 2 (eEF2) is the most abundant hibernation factor bound to 95% of 80S ribosomes and, unexpectedly, to 60S subunits. eEF2•GDP is stabilized by interactions with the sarcin-ricin loop and protein uL14. Hibernating ribosomes also feature La-related protein 1 (LARP1) involved in initiation and mTOR signaling, eIF5A implicated in elongation and termination, and other factors, exposing the variety of hibernation scenarios. Our work underscores the efficiency and potential of in extracto cryo-EM to discover native cellular complexes and mechanisms at near-atomic resolution.
items.title_zh: 在提取冷冻电镜下揭示eEF2为60S和80S颗粒的主要冬眠因子
items.summary_zh: 冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）在解析细胞大分子及其详细相互作用方面取得了显著进展。传统的单颗粒冷冻电镜依赖于纯化的大分子，缺乏细胞环境的复杂性，而原位冷冻电镜和冷冻电子断层成像（cryo-ET）则需要大量样本准备和数据采集，面临高分辨率的挑战。我们描述了细胞裂解液的冷冻电镜技术——在提取冷冻电镜，允许在细胞组分的背景下实现冷冻电镜的灵活性和高分辨率。高分辨率的二维模板匹配（2DTM）生成了约2.2 Å的哺乳动物翻译装置图谱。灵长类细胞系（MCF-7和BSC-1）和兔网织红细胞裂解液中的延伸核糖体丰度范围为约70%至10%，反映了翻译压力反应。非翻译（冬眠）核糖体不携带mRNA，特征是有众多蛋白质保护核糖体功能中心。延伸因子2（eEF2）是与95%的80S核糖体结合的最丰富的冬眠因子，意外地也与60S亚基结合。eEF2•GDP通过与sarcin-ricin环和蛋白uL14的相互作用得到稳定。冬眠核糖体还具有与启动和mTOR信号相关的La相关蛋白1（LARP1）、与延伸和终止相关的eIF5A及其他因子，揭示了其多样性。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，延伸因子2（eEF2）是主要的冬眠因子，广泛结合于80S和60S核糖体，揭示了其在细胞翻译压力反应中的重要角色。
items.l2_summary:
在冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）技术的发展中，研究者们通过在提取冷冻电镜的方法，成功揭示了延伸因子2（eEF2）作为60S和80S核糖体的主要冬眠因子。传统的单颗粒冷冻电镜通常依赖于纯化的大分子，缺乏细胞环境的复杂性，而原位冷冻电镜和冷冻电子断层成像（cryo-ET）则面临高分辨率和样本准备的挑战。为了解决这些问题，研究团队采用了细胞裂解液的冷冻电镜技术，使得在细胞组分的背景下实现了灵活性和高分辨率的观察。

通过高分辨率的二维模板匹配（2DTM），研究人员生成了约2.2 Å的哺乳动物翻译装置图谱，分析了灵长类细胞系（MCF-7和BSC-1）和兔网织红细胞裂解液中的延伸核糖体，发现其丰度范围为约70%至10%，这反映了细胞在翻译压力下的反应。研究还发现，非翻译（冬眠）核糖体不携带mRNA，且其功能中心被众多蛋白质保护。eEF2作为与95%的80S核糖体结合的最丰富的冬眠因子，意外地也与60S亚基结合。eEF2•GDP通过与sarcin-ricin环和蛋白uL14的相互作用得以稳定。

此外，冬眠核糖体还与启动和mTOR信号相关的La相关蛋白1（LARP1）、与延伸和终止相关的eIF5A及其他因子相互作用，揭示了其多样性。这些发现不仅为理解核糖体在细胞应激反应中的角色提供了新的视角，也为未来的研究指明了方向，尤其是在细胞翻译调控和冬眠机制的研究领域。

items.title: Sensitivity of the human temporal voice areas to nonhuman primate vocalizations
items.abstract: In recent years, research on voice processing in the human brain, particularly the study of temporal voice areas (TVAs), was dedicated almost exclusively to conspecific vocalizations. To characterize commonalities and differences regarding primate vocalization representations in the human brain, the inclusion of closely related nonhuman primates, namely chimpanzees and bonobos, is needed. We hypothesized that neural commonalities would depend on both phylogenetic and acoustic proximities, with chimpanzees ranking closest to Homo. Presenting human participants ( N = 23) with the vocalizations of four primate species (rhesus macaques, chimpanzees, bonobos, and humans) and regressing-out relevant acoustic parameters using three distinct analyses, we observed within-TVA, sample-specific, bilateral anterior superior temporal gyrus activity for chimpanzee vocalizations compared to: all other species; nonhuman primates; and human vocalizations. Within-TVA activity was also observed for macaque vocalizations. Our results provide evidence for subregions of the TVA that respond principally, but not exclusively, to phylogenetically and acoustically close nonhuman primate vocalizations, namely those of chimpanzees.
items.title_zh: 人类颞部语音区对非人类灵长类动物声音的敏感性
items.summary_zh: 近年来，人脑语音处理的研究，特别是颞部语音区（TVAs）的研究，几乎专注于同种动物的声音。为了表征人脑中灵长类动物声音表征的共性与差异，需要纳入与人类密切相关的非人类灵长类动物，如黑猩猩和倭黑猩猩。我们假设神经共性将依赖于系统发育和声学的接近性，其中黑猩猩与人类最为接近。我们向23名参与者呈现了四种灵长类动物（猕猴、黑猩猩、倭黑猩猩和人类）的声音，并通过三种不同的分析方法回归相关声学参数。结果显示，与其他物种、非人类灵长类动物及人类声音相比，黑猩猩声音在TVA内表现出特定的双侧前上颞回活动。猕猴声音也在TVA内观察到活动。我们的结果提供了证据，表明TVA的子区域主要但不 exclusively 对系统发育和声学上接近的非人类灵长类动物声音（即黑猩猩的声音）作出反应。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，人类颞部语音区对黑猩猩声音的反应最为显著，显示出该区域对非人类灵长类动物声音的敏感性与系统发育和声学接近性相关。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，关于人脑语音处理的研究，尤其是颞部语音区（TVAs）的研究，主要集中在同种动物的声音上。为了探讨人脑中灵长类动物声音表征的共性与差异，研究者们将目光投向与人类密切相关的非人类灵长类动物，如黑猩猩和倭黑猩猩。研究假设认为，神经共性将依赖于系统发育和声学的接近性，特别是黑猩猩与人类的亲缘关系最为密切。

在这项研究中，研究团队向23名参与者呈现了四种灵长类动物的声音，包括猕猴、黑猩猩、倭黑猩猩和人类，并通过三种不同的分析方法回归相关声学参数。结果显示，黑猩猩的声音在颞部语音区内表现出特定的双侧前上颞回活动，这一现象在其他非人类灵长类动物及人类的声音中并未观察到。此外，猕猴的声音也在颞部语音区内引发了活动。

这些结果提供了证据，表明颞部语音区的子区域主要但并非仅仅对系统发育和声学上接近的非人类灵长类动物声音（尤其是黑猩猩的声音）作出反应。这一发现不仅深化了我们对人类与非人类灵长类动物之间语音处理机制的理解，也为未来的相关研究提供了新的视角，强调了在研究人类语言和声音处理时考虑非人类灵长类动物的重要性。

items.title: Frequency and laminar profile of feature-specific visual activity revealed by interleaved EEG–fMRI
items.abstract: The role of cortical oscillations in brain function has been extensively debated, resulting in a variety of theoretical frameworks. Using interleaved simultaneous electroencephalography–functional magnetic resonance imaging, we examined the layer-specific relationship between oscillatory activity and visual processing. We could demonstrate that γ band activity positively correlates with feature-specific signals in superficial layers, but we were able to report a deep layer contribution as well. In addition, we could demonstrate that α band power not only correlates negatively with the feature-unspecific BOLD signal but is related to feature-specific BOLD as well. Lower frequency α was predominantly related to feature-unspecific superficial layer BOLD, while upper frequency α was found to be related to feature-specific BOLD in superficial and deep layers. We conclude that the role of α band oscillations extends beyond widespread inhibition and might be involved in active stimulus processing on the level of visual features.
items.title_zh: 特征特异性视觉活动的频率与层次特征通过交替EEG-fMRI揭示
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了皮层振荡在大脑功能中的作用，采用交替的同时脑电图（EEG）与功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术，分析了振荡活动与视觉处理之间的层特异性关系。结果表明，γ波活动与表层特征特异性信号呈正相关，同时也发现了深层的贡献。此外，α波功率不仅与特征非特异性BOLD信号呈负相关，还与特征特异性BOLD信号相关。低频α波主要与特征非特异性表层BOLD相关，而高频α波则与表层和深层的特征特异性BOLD相关。我们得出结论，α波振荡的作用超越了广泛抑制，可能参与视觉特征层面的主动刺激处理。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了皮层振荡在视觉处理中的层特异性作用，特别是γ波与特征特异性信号的正相关及α波在特征处理中的复杂角色。
items.l2_summary:
本研究通过交替的脑电图（EEG）与功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术，探讨了皮层振荡在大脑视觉处理中的作用，重点分析了振荡活动与视觉特征处理之间的层特异性关系。研究发现，γ波活动与表层特征特异性信号之间存在正相关关系，同时也观察到了深层的贡献。这表明，γ波在视觉特征的处理过程中起到了重要的积极作用。

此外，研究还发现α波功率与特征非特异性BOLD（血氧水平依赖）信号呈负相关，而与特征特异性BOLD信号则呈正相关。具体而言，低频α波主要与特征非特异性表层BOLD信号相关，而高频α波则与表层和深层的特征特异性BOLD信号均有关系。这一发现提示我们，α波的作用不仅限于广泛的抑制机制，可能还参与了视觉特征层面的主动刺激处理。

综上所述，本研究揭示了不同频率的皮层振荡在视觉处理中的复杂作用，尤其是α波和γ波在特征特异性与非特异性信号中的不同角色，为理解大脑如何处理视觉信息提供了新的视角。

items.title: A biochemical mechanism for Stu2/XMAP215-family microtubule polymerases
items.abstract: Defining quantitative biochemical mechanisms of microtubule dynamics and regulation is a current challenge. Stu2/XMAP215-family polymerases use tubulin-binding TOG domains to catalyze microtubule growth, but how polymerase activity results from the number and tubulin-binding properties of TOGs is not understood. We tested whether an enzyme-like biochemical model for the unrelated actin polymerase Ena/VASP could be applied to quantitatively relate Stu2 microtubule polymerase activity to the number of its TOGs, and the rate constants governing their interactions with tubulin. Stu2 activity displayed enzyme-like characteristics consistent with the biochemical model: Stu2 stimulated microtubule growth rates with hyperbolic dependence on tubulin concentration, and the amount of Stu2 on the microtubule end did not vary with tubulin concentration (microtubule growth rate). Complementary measurements of TOG:tubulin binding revealed high affinity (10 nM) and slow dissociation (0.03 s –1 ). The polymerase and binding measurements can be unified within the biochemical model: Stu2 operates with high efficiency, acting as a tubulin-shuttling antenna on the microtubule end that is primarily limited by the rate of tubulin:TOG association. Our work thus provides a quantitative biochemical mechanism for TOG-based polymerases. That unrelated microtubule and actin polymerases use the same enzyme-like mechanism provides an example of convergent evolution in the cytoskeleton.
items.title_zh: Stu2/XMAP215家族微管聚合酶的生化机制
items.summary_zh: 定义微管动态和调控的定量生化机制是当前的挑战。Stu2/XMAP215家族聚合酶利用结合微管蛋白的TOG结构域催化微管生长，但聚合酶活性如何与TOG的数量及其结合特性相关尚不清楚。我们测试了是否可以将与Ena/VASP无关的肌动蛋白聚合酶的酶样生化模型应用于定量关联Stu2微管聚合酶活性与TOG数量及其与微管蛋白相互作用的速率常数。Stu2活性表现出与生化模型一致的酶样特征：Stu2以双曲线依赖于微管蛋白浓度刺激微管生长速率，且微管末端的Stu2量不随微管蛋白浓度变化。TOG与微管蛋白结合的测量显示出高亲和力（10 nM）和缓慢解离（0.03 s –1）。聚合酶和结合测量可以在生化模型中统一：Stu2以高效能运作，作为微管末端的微管蛋白转运天线，主要受微管蛋白与TOG结合速率的限制。因此，我们的工作为基于TOG的聚合酶提供了定量生化机制。
items.l1_lead: Stu2/XMAP215家族微管聚合酶的活性与TOG数量及其与微管蛋白结合特性密切相关，提供了定量生化机制的基础。
items.l2_summary:
Stu2/XMAP215家族微管聚合酶的生化机制是当前研究的一个重要挑战，尤其是在理解微管动态和调控方面。Stu2/XMAP215家族聚合酶通过其TOG（TOG结构域）结合微管蛋白，催化微管的生长。然而，聚合酶活性与TOG的数量及其结合特性之间的关系尚不明确。为此，研究者们测试了是否可以将与Ena/VASP无关的肌动蛋白聚合酶的酶样生化模型应用于定量分析Stu2微管聚合酶的活性、TOG数量及其与微管蛋白相互作用的速率常数。

研究结果表明，Stu2的活性与生化模型一致，表现出酶样特征：Stu2的微管生长速率与微管蛋白浓度呈双曲线依赖关系，且微管末端的Stu2量在不同微管蛋白浓度下保持不变。此外，TOG与微管蛋白结合的测量结果显示出高亲和力（10 nM）和缓慢的解离速率（0.03 s⁻¹）。这些数据表明，Stu2作为微管末端的微管蛋白转运天线，具有高效能的运作，其主要受限于微管蛋白与TOG的结合速率。

通过将聚合酶和结合测量统一于生化模型中，研究为基于TOG的聚合酶提供了定量生化机制的理解。这一发现不仅深化了对Stu2/XMAP215家族微管聚合酶的认识，也为未来相关研究提供了重要的理论基础。

items.title: Complementary vertebrate Wac models exhibit phenotypes relevant to DeSanto-Shinawi Syndrome
items.abstract: Monogenic syndromes are associated with neurodevelopmental changes that result in cognitive impairments and neurobehavioral phenotypes, including autism and seizures. Limited studies and resources are available to make meaningful headway into the underlying molecular mechanisms that result in these symptoms. One such example is DeSanto-Shinawi Syndrome (DESSH), a rare disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the WAC gene. Individuals with DESSH syndrome exhibit a recognizable craniofacial gestalt, developmental delay/intellectual disability, neurobehavioral symptoms that include autism, ADHD, behavioral difficulties, and seizures. However, no thorough studies from a vertebrate model exist to understand how these changes occur. To overcome this, we developed both murine and zebrafish Wac/wac deletion mutants and studied whether their phenotypes recapitulate those described in individuals with DESSH syndrome. We first show that the two Wac models exhibit craniofacial and behavioral changes, reminiscent of abnormalities found in DESSH syndrome. In addition, each model revealed impacts on GABAergic neurons and further studies showed that the mouse mutants are susceptible to seizures, changes in brain volumes that are different between sexes and relevant behaviors. Finally, we uncovered transcriptional impacts of Wac loss-of-function in mice that will pave the way for future molecular studies into DESSH. These studies present two new vertebrate models that begin to uncover biological underpinnings of DESSH syndrome and elucidate the biology of Wac .
items.title_zh: 互补脊椎动物Wac模型展现与DeSanto-Shinawi综合征相关的表型
items.summary_zh: 单基因综合征与神经发育变化相关，导致认知障碍和神经行为表型，包括自闭症和癫痫。DeSanto-Shinawi综合征（DESSH）是一种由WAC基因致病变异引起的罕见疾病，患者表现出可识别的颅面特征、发育迟缓/智力障碍以及包括自闭症、注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）、行为困难和癫痫等神经行为症状。为了解这些变化的机制，我们开发了小鼠和斑马鱼的Wac/wac缺失突变体，并研究其表型是否与DESSH综合征患者相似。结果显示，两种Wac模型均表现出颅面和行为变化，类似于DESSH综合征的异常。此外，模型显示对GABA能神经元的影响，小鼠突变体易感癫痫，且性别间脑体积变化和相关行为存在差异。最后，我们揭示了小鼠Wac功能缺失的转录影响，为未来的分子机制研究奠定基础。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，Wac基因缺失的小鼠和斑马鱼模型展现出与DeSanto-Shinawi综合征相似的颅面特征和神经行为变化，为理解该综合征的机制提供了新线索。
items.l2_summary:
DeSanto-Shinawi综合征（DESSH）是一种由WAC基因（WAC gene）致病变异引起的罕见疾病，患者通常表现出明显的颅面特征、发育迟缓和智力障碍，以及自闭症、注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）、行为困难和癫痫等神经行为症状。为了探讨这些表型变化的机制，研究团队开发了小鼠和斑马鱼的Wac/wac缺失突变体，并对其表型进行了系统研究。结果表明，这两种Wac模型均表现出与DESSH综合征相似的颅面和行为变化，进一步验证了WAC基因在神经发育中的重要性。

在小鼠模型中，研究发现其对GABA能神经元的影响显著，突变体表现出癫痫的易感性。此外，研究还观察到性别间在脑体积变化和相关行为上的差异，这提示WAC基因可能在性别特异性神经发育中发挥作用。通过对小鼠Wac功能缺失的转录影响进行分析，研究为未来深入探讨DESSH综合征的分子机制奠定了基础。这些发现不仅加深了我们对DESSH综合征的理解，也为相关疾病的研究提供了新的模型和视角。

items.title: Role of insulin resistance in atherosclerosis: underlying mechanisms and emerging stem cell-based therapeutic strategies
items.abstract: Atherosclerosis, a chronic inflammatory disease of the arteries, is the primary cause of ischemic heart disease and stroke, which are the leading drivers of global mortality and major contributors to disability. Important risk factors for atherosclerosis include insulin resistance (IR), hypertension and hyperlipidemia. IR-induced endothelial dysfunction, inflammation, dyslipidemia, vascular remodeling, and prothrombotic effects represent central mechanistic links between IR and atherosclerosis. In this review, these mechanisms are summarized and discussed by incorporating emerging mechanistic insights into IR-induced trained immunity, tissue-selective IR, and mitochondrial dysfunction, with an emphasis on their contributions to atherosclerosis. Furthermore, emerging therapeutic strategies using mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) and their exosomes to improve IR are discussed, with a focus on their underlying mechanisms, as well as current challenges and outstanding issues in the field. While the current literature shows promising effects of MSCs and their exosomes in improving IR in cellular and animal models, clinical evidence remains limited. To harness the potential therapeutic benefits of MSCs and their exosomes, standardized manufacturing protocols and optimal routes of administration and dosing need to be determined.

items.title: Correction: From clinical records to community care: using real-world evidence in Ayurveda
Editorial: Gut microbiome-driven pathogenesis and intervention strategies in liver diseases
Angiogenesis in temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis: an update on mechanisms and research advances
items.abstract: Temporomandibular joint osteoarthritis (TMJOA) is a chronic degenerative disorder characterized by condylar cartilage degeneration, abnormal subchondral bone remodeling, and synovial inflammation. Its pathogenesis is complex, and effective clinical interventions remain limited. In recent years, the critical role of angiogenesis in TMJOA pathogenesis has garnered increasing attention. During TMJOA progression, angiogenesis interacts dynamically with bone metabolism, playing a key role in the imbalance of subchondral bone remodeling, amplification of synovial inflammation, and acceleration of cartilage degradation. Understanding the specific mechanisms of angiogenesis in TMJOA is of great significance for developing novel therapeutic strategies. This article systematically reviews the core regulatory network of angiogenesis in the pathological mechanisms of TMJOA and prospects future research directions, aiming to provide a theoretical basis for mechanistic studies and clinical translation in TMJOA.

items.title: Chemistry-medicine interdisciplinary integration in medical education: a narrative review of teaching reform, evidence synthesis, and international perspectives
items.abstract: Medical chemistry serves as an indispensable bridge connecting foundational chemical sciences with clinical medicine, yet traditional discipline-based teaching models create a persistent gap between chemical principles and clinical practice. This narrative review establishes a five-dimensional analytical framework—driving forces, curriculum restructuring, pedagogical innovation, practical translation, and outcome evaluation—developed from the multidisciplinary-interdisciplinary-transdisciplinary integration continuum, competency-based medical education theory, and constructive alignment principles. The framework, with the traditional discipline-based teaching model as the comparison baseline, is applied to systematically examine 105 studies from 2016 to 2025, identified through a reproducible search protocol across PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus, ERIC, and CNKI. The analysis reveals a progressive evolution from knowledge-service to competency-construction paradigms across multiple national contexts. Curriculum restructuring has advanced through a complementary three-stage trajectory, with clinical-topic spiral modules demonstrating superior knowledge transfer in settings with established cross-disciplinary faculty collaboration. Pedagogical innovation has achieved contrastive complementarity between case-based and problem-based learning, supported by Bayesian network meta-analysis evidence, though reported effect sizes are moderated by implementation fidelity, class size, and assessment alignment. Experimental teaching reform has progressed along a four-stage trajectory toward interdisciplinary innovative experiments, with virtual simulation addressing infrastructure constraints in resource-limited settings. A multi-level assessment framework, operationalized through an instrument-outcome matrix linking knowledge, clinical reasoning, practical skills, and long-term outcomes, is proposed to replace the current fragmented evaluation landscape. Three persistent bottlenecks—cross-disciplinary faculty development, resource integration mechanisms, and evaluation standard unification—constrain further progress. The review's findings are framed with appropriate caution, acknowledging the predominance of single-center small-sample studies that limit generalizability, and recognizing that high-quality educational research can employ diverse methodologies beyond randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Reconstruction-aware radiomics for risk stratification of subsolid pulmonary nodules: technical evidence, clinical limits, and translation priorities
items.abstract: Subsolid pulmonary nodules (SSNs), including pure ground-glass nodules (pGGNs) and part-solid nodules (PSNs), span transient inflammatory abnormalities and adenocarcinoma-spectrum lesions with widely different management implications. This critical narrative review treats CT reconstruction as part of the quantitative biomarker definition and asks whether targeted or high-spatial-resolution reconstruction provides stable, task-specific information beyond standardized thin-section CT. Evidence was synthesized across direct SSN reconstruction-domain studies, technical robustness studies, and clinical prediction studies. Direct imaging studies support improved depiction of selected fine structures, while same-scan GGN evidence demonstrates substantial pixel-size dependence of radiomic features and model composition. However, most clinical models were not evaluated in paired reconstruction domains, external validation with calibration remains uncommon, and no prospective study demonstrating management or patient benefit from reconstruction-aware radiomics in SSNs was identified in the literature reviewed. Persistent pGGNs provide a biological and technical rationale for investigating incremental quantitative information, but greater benefit than in PSNs has not been demonstrated. In PSNs, any model must add value beyond solid-component measurements, consolidation-to-tumor ratio, morphology, and longitudinal growth. Translation therefore requires reconstruction and segmentation robustness testing, strong conventional comparators, external calibration, prespecified thresholds, and prospective decision-linked evaluation. Until such benefit and safety are demonstrated, reconstruction-aware radiomics should remain investigational or confined to governed, domain-checked decision-support pathways.

items.title: Digital health-enabled life-course management of endometriosis: from early recognition and assisted diagnosis to symptom monitoring and self-management
items.abstract: Endometriosis is a chronic inflammatory disease that often requires longitudinal care across recognition, diagnostic assessment, symptom control, fertility planning, treatment transitions, and recurrence reassessment. The information required for these decisions is frequently fragmented across patient experience, clinical encounters, imaging, treatment history, and health-system records. This narrative Review synthesizes digital-health applications in endometriosis according to clinical function, data source, and translational maturity. Literature was identified through structured searches of major biomedical databases and targeted reference screening, with emphasis on clinically relevant validation, prospective evaluation, and implementation evidence. The most mature applications include structured electronic symptom capture, electronic patient-reported outcomes, selected app- or telehealth-based support, and digital pain interventions. AI/ML approaches for imaging, risk estimation, molecular classification, fertility outcomes, and recurrence prediction are technically active but are commonly limited by internal validation, uncertain calibration and action thresholds, and sparse prospective clinical-utility evidence. We propose a clinician-supervised life-course framework in which patient-expressed data, clinical and imaging information, treatment history, fertility goals, and follow-up data are integrated to support early recognition, assisted diagnosis, monitoring, shared decisions, and reassessment. The target state is clinical coherence rather than maximal data capture, supported by explicit institutional responsibility for review, escalation, feedback, privacy, equity, and human oversight. Progress toward routine use will depend on external validation, interoperable data architecture, low-burden measurement, prospective pathway evaluation, and accountable implementation.

items.title: Machine learning and nomogram for predicting severity of acute cholangitis: development and internal validation of a dual-framework model in a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract: BackgroundAccurate severity grading of acute cholangitis (AC) according to the Tokyo Guidelines 2018 (TG18) is essential for guiding biliary drainage decisions and intensive care allocation, yet bedside application of the multi-parameter grading system remains challenging. Existing prediction models are predominantly binary and lack interpretable clinical tools.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study enrolled 1,918 consecutive patients with acute cholangitis graded by TG18 at a single tertiary hepatobiliary centre (2021–2025). Random forest (RF), XGBoost, and support vector machine (SVM) were trained on seven LASSO-selected variables for three-class Grade I/II/III prediction. A separate eight-variable logistic regression nomogram distinguished Grade I from Grade II/III. Models were developed on a 70% training set (n = 1,342) and evaluated on a 30% held-out internal test set (n = 576) using bootstrap confidence intervals.ResultsRF achieved macro-AUC 0.84 (95% CI: 0.81–0.87), overall accuracy 72.2% and balanced accuracy 64.9%; XGBoost performed comparably (macro-AUC 0.84, accuracy 71.9%). Per-class recall for RF was 0.83 (Grade I), 0.56 (Grade II) and 0.56 (Grade III), indicating that almost half of Grade II cases were not correctly identified. The nomogram yielded AUC 0.85 (0.82–0.88), sensitivity 0.72, specificity 0.82, and negative predictive value 0.82 at the Youden reference threshold of 0.47; operating characteristics at other thresholds, including a sensitivity-weighted rule-out threshold, are reported in the Supplementary Material. Decision curve analysis suggested potential net benefit across the evaluated range of threshold probabilities. SHAP analysis identified platelet count, age, and serum albumin as the top predictors.ConclusionsA dual-framework combining ML-based three-class severity grading and a nomogram for binary triage may provide complementary support for standardising TG18 severity assessment. Both frameworks predict the TG18 grade itself rather than downstream clinical outcomes, and Grade II recognition remains limited; they should therefore be regarded as adjuncts to—not replacements for—TG18 assessment. Prospective multicentre validation against clinical outcomes is required before any clinical use.

items.title: Effectiveness of a multicomponent PDCA-based infusion safety management strategy in patients with pulmonary tuberculosis: a non-randomized historical-control study
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo evaluate the association between a multicomponent PDCA-based infusion safety management strategy and intraoperative peripheral intravenous (PIV) outcomes in adults with pulmonary tuberculosis.MethodsThis non-randomized historical-control study included 92 adults undergoing thoracic surgery: 46 historical controls receiving routine infusion management and 46 patients receiving a multicomponent intervention integrating PDCA-based quality improvement, staff training, standardized protocols, interdepartmental collaboration, audit and feedback, and two auxiliary devices. Baseline demographic and surgical characteristics were comparable between groups.ResultsCompared with historical controls, the intervention group had lower rates of erythema/tenderness [8.7% vs. 69.6%; RR, 0.13 (95% CI, 0.05–0.33)], catheter dislodgement [2.2% vs. 28.3%; RR, 0.08 (95% CI, 0.01–0.56)], and catheter occlusion [4.3% vs. 43.5%; RR, 0.10 (95% CI, 0.02–0.40); all P ≤ 0.001]. Catheter dwell time was longer [5.0 vs. 3.0 days; Hodges–Lehmann difference, +2.0 days (95% CI, 1.0–2.0)], whereas hospital stay was shorter [11.0 vs. 19.0 days; difference, −7.0 days (95% CI, −10.0 to −5.0)]. Satisfaction scores were also higher [95.0 vs. 91.5; difference, +3.0 points (95% CI, 2.0–4.0); all P < 0.001].ConclusionThe multicomponent PDCA-based strategy was associated with fewer PIV-related safety events, longer catheter dwell time, and higher satisfaction. However, because the intervention combined process changes with two devices and used a historical control, the observed differences cannot be attributed independently to PDCA or either device.

items.title: A hybrid deep learning–based OCR model for handwritten medical prescriptions
items.abstract: The current trend involving the use of paper-based medical prescriptions and the exchange of such by the social media is a major problem in automated and accurate text extraction in healthcare processes. This paper suggests a complete smart pipeline to digitize the images of medical prescriptions with lightweight deep learning-based classification, specialized Optical Character Recognition (OCR) engines, and comparative benchmarking of results using a large language model (LLM). The web scraped images of medical prescriptions are initially processed through a GhostNetV2 classifier to differentiate between handwritten and digital medical prescriptions. According to this choice, digital images are sent to PaddleOCR, and handwritten images are considered in Tesseract OCR so that each image could be processed by the best suitable recognition engine. The OCR outputs from both branches are benchmarked against GPT-4o (OpenAI) as an independent baseline to assess competitive performance and provide error-rate context. Experimental analysis shows that the suggested adaptive routing strategy is characterized by the fact that it has a high classification rate and the character and word error rates are significantly lower than those single-OCR techniques. The system is competitive with, though does not exceed, the raw accuracy of a state-of-the-art LLM-based OCR baseline (GPT-4o), while offering practical advantages in cost, transparency, and on-premises deployability that the black-box, per-call LLM baseline does not. The findings verify that the combination of lightweight classifiers and multi-OCR decision routing and multi-LLM-aided comparative benchmarking offers a scalable and robust solution to real-world medical prescriptions digitization, which adds to better automation, accuracy, and safety in healthcare information processing.

items.title: Clinical characteristics and mortality risk of sarcopenia in interstitial lung disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract: ObjectiveSarcopenia, prevalent in interstitial lung disease (ILD), increases the risk of poor outcomes. This study aimed to define the clinical characteristics of ILD patients with sarcopenia (ILD-S) and quantify sarcopenia's impact on mortality.MethodsWe systematically searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus for English studies up to 1 September 2026 reporting clinical variables (mean ± SD) in ILD vs. ILD-S groups and adjusted hazard ratios with 95% confidence intervals (CI) for mortality risk. Subgroup analyses were stratified by sarcopenia diagnostic criteria, ILD subtype, and survival time. Heterogeneity was assessed using Cochran's Q and I2 statistics. Sensitivity analyses (leave-one-out) and publication bias assessments (Egger's test, trim-and-fill method) were performed.ResultsFourteen studies comprising 1,546 participants (628 with ILD-S) were included. Compared with ILD patients without sarcopenia, those with ILD-S were significantly older (WMD = 3.03, 95% CI: 2.12–3.93), had higher Gender-Age-Physiology (GAP) scores (WMD = 0.43, 95% CI: 0.15 to 0.71), and a higher FEV₁/FVC ratio (WMD = 1.97, 95% CI: 0.21 to 3.73, P = 0.03). Conversely, the ILD-S group showed lower values for FEV₁% predicted (WMD = −6.95, 95% CI: −9.80 to −4.09), FVC% predicted (WMD = −9.46, 95% CI: −12.04 to −6.88), DLCO% predicted (WMD = −5.87, 95% CI: −11.68 to −0.06), body mass index (WMD = −1.35, 95% CI: −1.89 to −0.82), handgrip strength (WMD = −12.80, 95% CI: −17.02 to −8.58), 6-minute walk distance (WMD = −31.01, 95% CI: −60.05 to −1.97), and appendicular skeletal muscle index (WMD = −1.45, 95% CI: −2.15 to −0.76). No significant difference was observed in smoking history. Sarcopenia was strongly associated with increased mortality risk (HR = 2.02, 95% CI: 1.67 to 2.45), and this association remained stable across different follow-up periods. Sensitivity and publication bias analyses confirmed the robustness of the findings.ConclusionPatients with ILD-S exhibit a distinctive profile characterized by older age, higher GAP scores, poorer pulmonary function, lower BMI, reduced muscle strength and mass, and significantly elevated mortality. Systematic recognition of these clinical features may facilitate early identification of ILD-S and inform the development of targeted interventions to improve patient outcomes.Systematic Review Registrationhttps://inplasy.com/, INPLASY202570030.

items.title: Admission C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio and serum creatinine in relation to in-hospital mortality in non-HIV tuberculous meningitis: a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract: BackgroundThe independent and joint associations of admission C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) and serum creatinine with mortality in tuberculous meningitis (TBM) remain uncertain.MethodsWe analyzed a single-center retrospective cohort of non-HIV patients hospitalized with TBM from October 2013 to January 2024. Exposure measurements were the first tests within 24 h of admission, before acute interventions. Multivariable logistic regression modeled both exposures continuously, adjusted for age nonlinearly and prespecified covariates, and tested exposure nonlinearity and interaction. Covariate-only multiple imputation generated 20 datasets. Cohort-specific upper-quartile groups were descriptive. An adult sensitivity analysis used estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) calculated with the 2021 CKD-EPI equation.ResultsAmong 1,574 eligible patients, 187 died in hospital. The primary analysis included 1,563 patients and all 187 deaths; 11 survivors lacked CAR (n = 3) or creatinine (n = 8), without overlap. Creatinine showed evidence of nonlinearity (P = 0.022), whereas CAR did not (P = 0.105). The linear CAR estimate was near the null (adjusted odds ratio [OR] per doubling, 1.02; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.88–1.18); the interaction P value was 0.065. Relative to serum creatinine of 48 µmol/L, adjusted ORs for death were 1.31 (95% CI: 1.11–1.55) at 65 µmol/L, 1.49 (1.15–1.92) at 80 µmol/L, and 1.62 (1.17–2.24) at 100 µmol/L. Descriptive group mortality ranged from 9.02% when both markers were below their 75th percentiles to 19.38% when both were at or above them. Among 1,372 adults, the OR per 10 mL/min/1.73 m2 lower eGFR was 1.045 (0.984–1.109; P = 0.150).ConclusionsAdmission creatinine had a nonlinear adjusted association with in-hospital mortality in non-HIV TBM. CAR yielded a near-null linear estimate, and the interaction analysis did not establish effect modification. Unmeasured neurological severity limits interpretation; these results do not define kidney dysfunction, a clinical cutoff, or a clinically useful prediction model.

items.title: Pathogen-targeted quick multiplex PCR identification of Chlamydia psittaci and Haemophilus influenzae coinfection in pneumonia: a case report
items.abstract: This study describes a rare case of pneumonia induced by coinfection with Chlamydia psittaci (C. psittaci) and Haemophilus influenzae (H. influenzae). The patient had a history of chronic nephritis and long-term pigeon breeding. The initial manifestation was slurred speech, followed by rapid progression to high fever and respiratory failure. Chest computed tomography revealed bilateral interstitial pneumonia, predominantly in the right lung. Pathogen-targeted quick multiplex polymerase chain reaction (pt-qPCR) confirmed the pathogens as C. psittaci and H. influenzae, and metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) further verified consistent results. After 7-days of combination therapy with doxycycline and azithromycin, the treatment was switched to doxycycline combined with moxifloxacin for an additional 8-days. The patient achieved complete recovery and was discharged from the hospital. This case suggests that pt-qPCR may facilitate early identification of mixed infections in patients with severe pneumonia and a history of avian exposure, thereby providing valuable information to guide clinical decision-making.

items.title: ADH7 and plasma proteins mediate smoking-related esophageal cancer: genetic causality and therapeutic insight
items.abstract: BackgroundSmoking has been linked to alterations in plasma protein profiles and increased risk of esophageal cancer (EC). However, the precise mediating roles of plasma proteins in this relationship remain unclear. This study explores the mediation effects of plasma proteins in smoking-associated EC, utilizing genetic proxies to uncover potential biological mechanisms underpinning this association.MethodsGenetic correlation and Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses were applied to examine the association between smoking traits and EC. Pathway enrichment analysis explored circulatory protein changes in smokers. A two-step mediation MR analysis identified key plasma proteins involved in smoking-related EC pathogenesis. Survival analysis assessed the impact of transcriptional levels of mediators on EC prognosis, while phenome-wide association studies (PheWAS) evaluated the safety of targeted molecules and investigated potential pleiotropy. The expression and function of ADH7 were evaluated by qRT-PCR and in vitro experiments.ResultsGenetic correlation analysis showed significant links between smoking and EC, supported by MR findings that confirmed a causal relationship. Smoking was found to influence pathways related to cytokine signaling, immune activation, and the STAT pathway. Five plasma proteins (ADH7, CPXM1, FUT3, GZMM, LYPD3) were identified as mediators in smoking-driven EC risk. Among these, ADH7 emerged as a key protein and was consistently associated with smoking traits; high ADH7 mRNA expression in EC tumor tissue was associated with reduced progression-free survival. PheWAS inferred that ADH7-targeted interventions might pose risks of neurological or psychiatric side effects, though these were not statistically significant. qRT-PCR and immunohistochemistry showed that ADH7 was downregulated in EC tissues relative to adjacent normal mucosa, and functional assays demonstrated that overexpression of ADH7 suppressed the proliferative and migratory capacity of EC cells. Serum ELISA further revealed that circulating ADH7 concentrations were elevated in smokers and in EC patients, with the highest levels observed in smoking EC patients, supporting a role for smoking-driven elevation of circulating ADH7 in EC risk.ConclusionsThis study reveals a compartment-specific, dual role for ADH7 in smoking-related EC: elevated circulating ADH7, driven in part by smoking, is associated with increased EC risk, whereas ADH7 acts as a tumor suppressor within esophageal tumor tissue. These findings provide novel genetic and mechanistic insights into smoking-related EC pathogenesis and highlight the importance of distinguishing circulating from tissue-level protein function when interpreting biomarker-disease associations.

items.title: Abdominal allergic reaction syndrome: a tentative definition
items.abstract: BackgroundSome patients with acute abdominal pain present with imaging findings suggestive of severe intestinal pathology, yet they remain hemodynamically stable and respond to corticosteroids rather than surgery. Recognizing this pattern early can prevent unnecessary laparotomy.CasesThree female patients (aged 91, 78, and 57 years) admitted to the emergency department presented with acute abdominal pain and diffuse bowel wall edema on a CT scan. Despite alarming imaging results, all three patients remained hemodynamically stable. The symptoms improved rapidly with intravenous methylprednisolone, and all patients were discharged without surgery.ConclusionsWe propose Abdominal Allergic Reaction Syndrome (AARS) as a preliminary recognition framework for this clinico-radiological pattern. AARS is not intended to replace specific diagnoses such as immunoglobulin A (IgA) vasculitis or lupus enteritis. Rather, it serves as an early identifier at a stage when the underlying etiology remains unclear. The core features (hemodynamic stability and clinico-radiological mismatch, supported by normal lactate levels) may help emergency physicians avoid unnecessary surgery while proceeding with the diagnostic workup. The term “allergic” is used here in its broader immunological sense (encompassing all type I–IV hypersensitivity reactions) and is not restricted to IgE-mediated reactions.

items.title: Development and internal validation of a CatBoost–SHAP-guided nomogram for significant liver fibrosis in children with chronic hepatitis B
items.abstract: BackgroundSignificant liver fibrosis can develop in children with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet liver biopsy is invasive and unsuitable for repeated assessment. We developed an interpretable, non-invasive prediction model for significant fibrosis in pediatric CHB and evaluated whether baseline risk stratification was associated with subsequent treatment outcomes.MethodsThis retrospective study included 232 children with CHB who underwent liver biopsy, with significant fibrosis defined as Scheuer stage S ≥ 2. Patients were randomly assigned to a development cohort (80%) and a held-out test set (20%). A CatBoost model with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization was used to identify the most informative predictors, and these variables were incorporated into a logistic regression nomogram guided by Shapley additive explanations (SHAP). Model performance was evaluated by discrimination, calibration, decision curve analysis, and DeLong testing. Associations between baseline risk groups and longitudinal outcomes were examined using generalized estimating equations adjusted for age and sex and Kaplan–Meier analyses.ResultsSignificant fibrosis was identified in 96 children (41.4%). Liver stiffness measurement, alanine aminotransferase, and platelet count were retained in the final model. The nomogram achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.828 (95% CI, 0.767–0.889) in the development cohort and 0.782 (95% CI, 0.637–0.927) in the held-out test cohort, with performance comparable to that of the CatBoost model (P = 0.240). Compared with the low-risk group, high-risk patients showed greater longitudinal reductions in alanine and aspartate aminotransferase, whereas longitudinal changes in liver stiffness measurement and hepatitis B virus DNA were similar between groups. Conversely, low-risk patients achieved virological suppression, HBeAg seroconversion, and biochemical response earlier than those classified as high risk.ConclusionsAn interpretable three-variable prediction model based on CatBoost-guided feature selection accurately identified significant fibrosis in children with CHB while maintaining performance comparable to the machine-learning model. Baseline risk stratification was also associated with subsequent treatment outcomes, although external validation is needed before clinical implementation.
